Accounting Administrator

At AA Service Company, we’re more than just a service company — we’re a team that takes pride in quality work, continuous learning, and doing what’s right for our customers and our people. Here, your contributions matter. You’ll be supported with ongoing training, growth opportunities, and a team that has your back every step of the way. When you succeed, we all succeed — and we make sure you’re rewarded for it. 

We’re looking for an organized, detail-oriented Accounting Administrator to support our day-to-day accounting and financial operations. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with numbers, analyzing data, resolving discrepancies, and keeping financial information accurate.

You’ll support a variety of functions, including accounts receivable, billing, collections, payroll, and commissions. If you’re a proactive problem-solver who takes pride in accuracy, enjoys working with Excel, and can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to meet you!

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: $52,000 annually with weekly pay!

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and paid holidays

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance 

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development

  • A supportive team environment where you can make an impact

  •  

What You’ll Do

  • Support daily accounts receivable activities, review AR reports, and follow up on outstanding balances.

  • Manage customer and membership billing, collections, and past-due accounts.

  • Research billing issues, payment discrepancies, and account questions, following each issue through resolution.

  • Assist with payroll processing and verify payroll information for accuracy.

  • Calculate, verify, and enter employee commission information into the appropriate systems.

  • Maintain accurate financial records and enter information into ServiceTitan and other systems.

  • Reconcile information across systems and investigate discrepancies.

  • Create, maintain, and update Excel spreadsheets and reports to organize and analyze financial and operational data.

  • Work with managers and other departments to gather information and resolve accounting questions.

  • Assist with month-end reporting, general office administration, special projects, and other accounting duties as needed.

  •  

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in accounting, finance, general office administration, or a related field.

  • Experience with accounts receivable, billing, payroll, collections, data entry, or reconciliations.

  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.

  • Basic to intermediate proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, especially Excel.

  • Experience with accounting software; ServiceTitan experience is strongly preferred.

  • Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, high-volume office environment.

  • A proactive, can-do attitude with the ability to work independently, take initiative, and solve problems.

  •  

What Will Make You Successful

We’re looking for someone who notices when something doesn’t look right, asks questions, digs into the details, and follows through until an issue is resolved. If you’re organized, comfortable working with numbers and data, and enjoy having a variety of responsibilities, this is an opportunity to contribute to a growing team while continuing to develop your accounting skills.

Join Our Team!

If you’re ready to bring your accounting and administrative skills to a collaborative team where accuracy, initiative, and problem-solving matter, we’d love to hear from you. Join AA Service Cmpany and grow your career with us!

Accounting Administrator

You’ll be supported with ongoing training, growth opportunities, and a team that has your back every step of the way. When you succeed, we all succeed — and we make sure you’re rewarded for it. 

We’re looking for an organized, detail-oriented Accounting Administrator to support our day-to-day accounting and financial operations. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with numbers, analyzing data, resolving discrepancies, and keeping financial information accurate.

You’ll support a variety of functions, including accounts receivable, billing, collections, payroll, and commissions. If you’re a proactive problem-solver who takes pride in accuracy, enjoys working with Excel, and can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to meet you!

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: $52,000 annually with weekly pay!

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and paid holidays

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance 

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development

  • A supportive team environment where you can make an impact

  •  

What You’ll Do

  • Support daily accounts receivable activities, review AR reports, and follow up on outstanding balances.

  • Manage customer and membership billing, collections, and past-due accounts.

  • Research billing issues, payment discrepancies, and account questions, following each issue through resolution.

  • Assist with payroll processing and verify payroll information for accuracy.

  • Calculate, verify, and enter employee commission information into the appropriate systems.

  • Maintain accurate financial records and enter information into ServiceTitan and other systems.

  • Reconcile information across systems and investigate discrepancies.

  • Create, maintain, and update Excel spreadsheets and reports to organize and analyze financial and operational data.

  • Work with managers and other departments to gather information and resolve accounting questions.

  • Assist with month-end reporting, general office administration, special projects, and other accounting duties as needed.

  •  

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in accounting, finance, general office administration, or a related field.

  • Experience with accounts receivable, billing, payroll, collections, data entry, or reconciliations.

  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.

  • Basic to intermediate proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications, especially Excel.

  • Experience with accounting software; ServiceTitan experience is strongly preferred.

  • Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, high-volume office environment.

  • A proactive, can-do attitude with the ability to work independently, take initiative, and solve problems.

  •  

What Will Make You Successful

We’re looking for someone who notices when something doesn’t look right, asks questions, digs into the details, and follows through until an issue is resolved. If you’re organized, comfortable working with numbers and data, and enjoy having a variety of responsibilities, this is an opportunity to contribute to a growing team while continuing to develop your accounting skills.

Join Our Team!

If you’re ready to bring your accounting and administrative skills to a collaborative team where accuracy, initiative, and problem-solving matter, we’d love to hear from you. Join AA Service Cmpany and grow your career with us!

Apprentice Plumber 

At Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric, we believe great service starts with great people. With a long-standing reputation for integrity, craftsmanship, and exceptional customer service, we’re committed to helping our team members grow and succeed.

If you’re hardworking, motivated, and ready to build a rewarding career in the skilled trades, this could be the perfect opportunity for you! No prior plumbing experience is required — just a positive attitude, a strong work ethic, and a willingness to learn.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist experienced plumbing technicians on job sites by gathering tools, delivering parts, and supporting daily service operations.

  • Work in the warehouse to learn plumbing parts, tools, equipment, inventory, and company procedures.

  • Participate in hands-on training, online technical courses, and ride-alongs with licensed plumbing technicians.

  • Learn the fundamentals of residential plumbing, including tools, materials, equipment, and service procedures.

  • Support technicians in delivering quality workmanship and exceptional customer service.

  • Assist with daily operational tasks and collaborate with team members to keep jobs running smoothly.

  • Cross-train on the dispatch desk and other operational functions as needed.

  • Take initiative, ask questions, and actively develop new skills through training and on-the-job experience.

  • Maintain a safe, organized, and professional work environment.

  • Demonstrate reliability, punctuality, and a commitment to learning and growing within the plumbing trade.

What We’re Looking For

  • No prior plumbing experience required — we’re looking for individuals with the right attitude and a desire to learn.

  • A strong interest in pursuing a career in plumbing or another skilled trade.

  • Hardworking, motivated, and goal-oriented, with a drive to succeed.

  • Strong attention to detail, critical-thinking skills, and the ability to follow instructions.

  • Excellent communication skills and a positive, team-oriented attitude.

  • Dependable attendance, punctuality, and strong time-management skills.

  • Willingness to take ownership of tasks, learn new skills, and go above and beyond daily responsibilities.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Flexibility to assist with warehouse operations, job-site support, and dispatch duties as needed.

  • Willingness and ability to work overtime when necessary.

  • Valid driver's license and a clean driving record preferred.

  • Previous experience in warehousing, logistics, delivery driving, automotive, dispatch, data entry, or customer service is a plus.

 

What We Offer

  • Starting pay of $16–$18 per hour.

  • Paid, hands-on training and mentorship from experienced professionals.

  • Structured career development and technical education.

  • A clear path toward becoming a licensed plumbing technician.

  • Opportunities to develop new skills and advance within the company.

  • A supportive, collaborative team environment.

  • The opportunity to build a rewarding, long-term career with an established company.

Ready to Get Started?

You don’t need to know everything about plumbing to get started — you just need the drive to learn and the determination to succeed. If you’re ready to work hard, learn from experienced professionals, and build a future in the skilled trades, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and take the first step toward a rewarding career in plumbing!

Accounts Receivable Specialist

Location: King of Prussia, PA
Schedule: Hybrid – 2–3 days per week in office
Compensation: $68,000–$71,000 annually

We are looking for an Accounts Receivable Specialist to support the accounting operations across our growing family of home services brands. This role is responsible for managing day-to-day accounts receivable activities for assigned stores, ensuring accurate and timely processing, recording, and reconciliation of financial transactions.

The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, experience in a back-office accounting environment, and a service-oriented mindset. This position serves as a key resource and primary point of contact for assigned stores, providing guidance, training, and support on AR processes and procedures while helping maintain accurate financial records across the organization.

This is an accounts receivable and accounting support role — it does not involve collections.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and paid holidays

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance

  • Paid training and professional development

  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement

 

What You'll Do

  • Manage day-to-day accounts receivable activities for assigned stores, including deposits, chargebacks, returned checks, and credit card refunds

  • Process and record financial transactions accurately and in a timely manner

  • Collaborate with internal teams and assigned stores to research discrepancies, identify root causes, and ensure timely resolution

  • Monitor unexported payments and invoices, partnering with assigned stores to ensure timely and accurate exporting

  • Provide guidance and training to assigned stores on AR processes and procedures, answering questions and ensuring consistent execution

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned stores regarding Loomis safe issues, coordinating timely resolution to ensure proper collection and recording of cash transactions

  • Process and record miscellaneous checks received at the Corporate office, ensuring payments are accurately posted to the appropriate general ledger (GL) accounts

  • Support accurate reconciliation and maintenance of AR-related records

  • Build strong working relationships with store personnel and provide responsive accounting support

  • Help standardize and improve AR processes as the organization continues to grow

  • Perform other accounts receivable and related accounting duties as needed

 

What We're Looking For

  • 2–3 years of experience in accounts receivable, accounting, or a related financial role

  • Strong understanding of accounts receivable processes, including cash application, deposits, payment processing, and reconciliations

  • Ability to investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and recommend solutions

  • Experience handling chargebacks, refunds, payments, and account reconciliation

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when processing financial transactions

  • A service-oriented mindset with the ability to build positive working relationships and provide responsive support to assigned stores

  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively in a team-oriented environment

  • Excellent time management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines

This role is responsible for managing day-to-day accounts receivable activities for assigned stores, ensuring accurate and timely processing, recording, and reconciliation of financial transactions.

  • Perform other accounts receivable and related accounting duties as needed

Comfort Advisor | Nashoba Air and Boilerworks

At Nashoba Air and Boilerworks, we like to say we are a Customer Service company that is amazingly successful in the Plumbing, Electrical, Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning business! Nashoba has been servicing Massachusetts and Southern New Hampshire homeowners since 2002 with reliable, trustworthy, and complete home services, with all recommended repairs backed by the Nashoba Air Guarantee.

We're looking for a motivated, results-driven Comfort Advisor who knows how to build relationships, understand customer needs, and close sales. In this role, you'll meet with homeowners to evaluate their heating and cooling needs, present customized comfort solutions, and help customers make confident decisions about their home comfort investments.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record in sales, thrives in a performance-driven environment, and takes pride in delivering an exceptional customer experience. Whether you're an experienced HVAC Comfort Advisor or a successful in-home sales professional looking for a new opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive, performance-based compensation with uncapped earning potential

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and paid holidays

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance

  • Paid training and professional development

  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement

 

What You'll Do

  • Conduct in-home consultations to evaluate homeowners' heating, cooling, and indoor air quality needs

  • Build trust with customers through a consultative, solutions-focused sales approach

  • Present customized HVAC replacement and upgrade options based on customer needs and budgets

  • Clearly explain equipment options, benefits, warranties, and available financing solutions

  • Prepare and present proposals, confidently ask for the sale, and follow through to close opportunities

  • Consistently meet or exceed individual sales goals and performance expectations

  • Follow up with prospective customers to answer questions and convert opportunities into sales

  • Utilize CRM systems to manage leads, track sales activity, and maintain accurate customer records

  • Collaborate with technicians, installation teams, and office staff to ensure a smooth customer experience

  • Identify opportunities to recommend additional comfort solutions, indoor air quality products, and maintenance memberships

  • Stay current on HVAC products, industry trends, and sales best practices

 

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals

  • Strong consultative selling and relationship-building skills

  • Ability to present solutions and confidently ask for the sale

  • Experience conducting in-home customer appointments

  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and customer service skills

  • Basic proficiency with CRM systems and mobile technology

  • Ability to work evenings and Saturdays as needed

  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in a performance-driven environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous HVAC Comfort Advisor or residential HVAC sales experience

  • Knowledge of residential heating, cooling, and indoor air quality systems

  • Experience presenting financing options and monthly payment solutions

  • Experience with both lead-generated and self-generated sales opportunities

  • Familiarity with ServiceTitan or similar field service management software

  • Experience selling maintenance memberships or service agreements

  • Background in in-home sales, including roofing, windows, solar, remodeling, or other home improvement industries

  • Residential HVAC technicians with strong customer communication and sales abilities

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently meets or exceeds sales goals and performance expectations

  • Builds strong customer relationships through trust, professionalism, and consultative selling

  • Confidently presents solutions and helps homeowners make informed purchasing decisions

  • Maintains strong closing rates and follows up on sales opportunities

  • Works collaboratively with technicians and installation teams to ensure customer satisfaction

  • Takes ownership of results and continuously looks for opportunities to improve

  • Delivers an exceptional customer experience from the initial consultation through the completed sale

 

Join Our Team!

If you're a driven sales professional who enjoys helping homeowners, building relationships, and being rewarded for your performance, we'd love to hear from you! Join Nashoba Air and Boilerworks and build a rewarding sales career with a team that puts customer service first.

Commercial HVAC Service Technician || NorthField, OH

Jackson Comfort 

Keep Homes Comfortable. Build a Career You'll Be Proud Of. 

At Jackson Comfort, we're more than just an HVAC company—we're a team that takes pride in doing things the right way. Our technicians are trusted advisors to our customers, solving problems with honesty, professionalism, and exceptional service. 

We're looking for an experienced Residential HVAC Service Technician who enjoys troubleshooting, takes pride in quality workmanship, and wants to be part of a company that values its people as much as its customers. 

If you're tired of working somewhere you're just a number, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

  • Diagnose, service, repair, and maintain commercial heating and cooling systems.

  • Work on packaged rooftop units, split systems, chillers, heat pumps, boilers, and related commercial equipment.

  • Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, system testing, and operational evaluations.

  • Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, airflow, hydronic, and control-system issues.

  • Clearly explain findings, recommended repairs, and next steps to customers.

  • Obtain customer authorization before performing additional work.

  • Collect payment on-site when appropriate.

  • Open and close jobs accurately within the electronic scheduling system.

  • Document arrival times, work performed, job completion, follow-up needs, and detailed service summaries.

  • Communicate parts, equipment, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.

  • Maintain clean, organized, and professional vehicles and jobsites.

  • Take responsibility for assigned trucks, diagnostic tools, equipment, uniforms, and inventory.

  • Train apprentices in the field and lead by example through safe, professional work practices.

  • Attend required technical training, team meetings, and company meetings.

  • Protect company and customer information and maintain appropriate confidentiality.

  • Build positive working relationships with customers, coworkers, apprentices, and leadership.

  • Receive and implement coaching and feedback professionally.

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous commercial HVAC service, maintenance, and repair experience.

  • Experience with packaged rooftop units, split systems, chillers, heat pumps, boilers, and related commercial systems.

  • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills.

  • Knowledge of refrigeration, electrical, airflow, hydronic, combustion, and control systems.

  • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

  • Ability to read wiring diagrams, equipment specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Strong communication and customer service skills.

  • Professional appearance and demeanor.

  • Ability to provide clear, complete, and timely service documentation.

  • Willingness and ability to train apprentices and less-experienced technicians.

  • Strong judgment, self-control, and respect for customer and company confidentiality.

  • Ability to accept and apply constructive feedback.

  • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and electronic scheduling systems.

  • EPA Universal Certification required.

  • Applicable HVAC trade license preferred.

  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

  • Ability to perform physical work on rooftops, in mechanical rooms, and in indoor and outdoor conditions.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation based on experience

  • Performance-based earning opportunities

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

  • 401(k) with Company Match

  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

  • Uniforms Provided

  • Career Advancement Opportunities

  • Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment

Apply today and grow with Jackson Comfort Services.

  • Dependable attendance and punctuality

Apply today and become part of the AA Service Co. team!

If you have home services experience and know your way around ServiceTitan, we'd love to meet you!

What You'll Do

  • Answer inbound customer calls for residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical services
  • Schedule service appointments using ServiceTitan
  • Provide exceptional customer service while resolving customer questions and concerns
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, technicians, and office staff
  • Maintain accurate customer records and detailed job notes
  • Prioritize emergency calls and schedule technicians efficiently
  • Promote maintenance memberships and additional services when appropriate
  • Support the team by helping create an outstanding customer experience from the first call to the completed job

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience as a Customer Service Representative in a residential HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or home services company
  • Working knowledge of residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical terminology
  • Experience using ServiceTitan for scheduling, call booking, and customer management
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong customer service and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to multitask and stay organized in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to remain calm, professional, and empathetic while handling customer concerns
  • Positive attitude and team-first mentality
  • Strong sense of accountability and ownership
  • Dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Sales-minded approach with the ability to identify opportunities for memberships, maintenance agreements, and additional services

What You'll Get

  • $25–$27 per hour based on experience
  • Full-time, year-round position
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Paid Time Off and paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Ongoing training and career growth opportunities
  • Supportive team environment with opportunities to advance

Why AA Service Co.?

We're more than just a home services company—we're a team that believes in taking care of our customers and each other. If you're dependable, customer-focused, and enjoy being part of a company that values teamwork, accountability, and exceptional service, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of the AA Service Co. team!

Triangle Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electrical – Bellefonte, PA

Customer Service Representative

Be the First Impression of a 5-Star Home Services Company

At Triangle Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electrical, we believe exceptional customer service begins with the very first phone call. As a Customer Service Representative, you'll play a critical role in creating outstanding customer experiences while helping homeowners schedule the services they need.

Serving Central Pennsylvania, Triangle provides residential heating, cooling, plumbing, drain, and electrical services under one roof. Our continued growth is built on exceptional customer care, teamwork, and a commitment to doing the right thing for every customer. We offer year-round work, ongoing training, competitive compensation, and opportunities to grow your career within a supportive, family-oriented culture.

Why Join Triangle?

  • Competitive compensation

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

  • 401(k) with Company Match

  • Paid Time Off

  • Paid Training and Professional Development

  • Year-Round Stable Employment

  • Career Growth Opportunities

  • Family-Oriented Culture

  • Supportive Leadership Team

The Role

As a Customer Service Representative, you'll be the primary point of contact for our customers, ensuring every interaction is professional, friendly, and solution-oriented. You'll schedule service appointments, support our dispatch team, maintain accurate customer information, and help deliver an exceptional customer experience from the first call through job completion.

Key Responsibilities

  • Convert inbound customer calls into booked service appointments.

  • Make outbound calls to schedule maintenance visits, follow up on open opportunities, and support membership and seasonal campaigns.

  • Deliver exceptional customer service while resolving customer questions and concerns professionally.

  • Coordinate with dispatch to maximize technician efficiency and appointment availability.

  • Maintain accurate customer records and update information within the company's operating system.

  • Promote maintenance agreements and additional services when appropriate.

  • Communicate effectively with technicians, dispatchers, and management to ensure a seamless customer experience.

  • Meet individual and team performance goals while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

  • Participate in ongoing training and contribute to a positive, team-oriented work environment.

Qualifications

  • Previous customer service, call center, dispatch, or administrative experience preferred.

  • Experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other home service industries is a plus.

  • Excellent communication and active listening skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.

  • Ability to multitask and remain calm in a fast-paced environment.

  • Comfortable working with computers and learning scheduling or CRM software.

  • Positive attitude with a strong work ethic and team-first mentality.

  • ServiceTitan experience is preferred but not required.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating outstanding customer experiences, maximizing booked appointments, supporting efficient field operations, and helping Triangle continue delivering the five-star service our customers have come to expect.

Excellent phone presence and communication skills 

Strong organization and attention to detail 

Ability to multitask and prioritize in a busy environment 

Comfortable handling upset or frustrated customers 

Basic computer proficiency and ability to learn new software quickly 

Strong written communication skills 

Dependable, positive, and team-oriented

Takes pride in quality work and attention to detail

401(k) with company match 

Paid time off and paid holidays 

Company-paid life and disability insurance 

Paid training and professional development 

Opportunities for career growth and advancement 

 

 Apply today to join Tristate Home Services as a Customer Service Representative!

At TriState Home Services, we give skilled professionals the opportunity to focus on what they do best—taking care of customers and delivering quality work. 

You’ll have steady demand, strong support from dispatch and operations, and opportunities to continue building your skills and career. We’re looking for dependable, customer-focused people who want to be part of a team that values professionalism and accountability. 

Job Description 

We are looking for a friendly, organized Customer Service Representative who can handle a busy phone, solve problems, and make sure every customer feels taken care of. 

Job Duties 

Answer incoming calls and provide a professional, friendly customer experience 

Schedule service appointments and gather accurate customer information 

Listen to customer concerns and ask the right questions to understand their needs 

Handle multiple calls, tasks, and priorities in a fast-paced environment 

Follow up with customers as needed 

Identify opportunities for additional services and maintenance plans 

Enter and maintain accurate customer information in company systems 

Communicate with dispatchers, technicians, and other team members 

Handle customer concerns calmly and professionally 

Assist with administrative tasks and special projects as needed 

 

Skills & Experience 

1+ years of customer service, call center, or home services experience preferred 

Excellent phone presence and communication skills 

Strong organization and attention to detail 

Ability to multitask and prioritize in a busy environment 

Comfortable handling upset or frustrated customers 

Basic computer proficiency and ability to learn new software quickly 

Strong written communication skills 

Dependable, positive, and team-oriented 

HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or Service Titan experience is a plus 

 

What Success Looks Like 

Shows up ready to work and follows through on commitments 

Takes pride in quality work and attention to detail 

Communicates clearly with customers and teammates 

Works safely and follows established processes 

Takes ownership, solves problems, and is willing to keep learning 

 

Benefits 

Medical, dental, and vision insurance 

401(k) with company match 

Paid time off and paid holidays 

Company-paid life and disability insurance 

Paid training and professional development 

Opportunities for career growth and advancement 

 

 Apply today to join Tristate Home Services as a Customer Service Representative!

Customer Service Representative | Stoneham, MA

At Sila Boston, we take care of our people, invest in great tools and training, and provide real opportunities to grow. You’ll have a strong team behind you and the resources of a growing company, without losing that local team feel.

We're proud to be an official partner of the Boston Bruins! Our partnership reflects our commitment to teamwork, excellence, and being part of the Boston community.

We’re looking for a friendly, organized Customer Service Representative who can manage a busy phone line, solve problems, and make sure every customer feels taken care of. You’ll play an important role in creating a positive customer experience, coordinating service appointments, and supporting our technicians and dispatch team.

The ideal candidate has strong communication skills, enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, and takes pride in delivering excellent customer service.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: $25–$32/hour

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and paid holidays

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance

  • Paid training and professional development

  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement

 

What You’ll Do

  • Answer incoming calls and provide a professional, friendly customer experience

  • Schedule service appointments and gather accurate customer information

  • Listen to customer concerns and ask the right questions to understand their needs

  • Manage multiple calls, tasks, and priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Follow up with customers as needed

  • Identify opportunities for additional services and maintenance plans

  • Enter and maintain accurate customer information in company systems

  • Communicate with dispatchers, technicians, and other team members

  • Handle customer concerns calmly and professionally

  • Assist with administrative tasks and special projects as needed

 

What We’re Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications:

  • Previous customer service experience

  • Basic computer knowledge and comfort navigating different systems

  • Strong communication and phone skills

  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment

  • Excellent organization and attention to detail

  • A dependable, positive, and team-oriented attitude
 

Preferred Experience & Skills:

  • Home services experience, particularly HVAC, plumbing, or electrical

  • ServiceTitan experience

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Teams and Outlook

  • Experience with Angi, Contractor Commerce, Hatch, and Google Local Services Ads (LSA)

  • Ability to remain calm and professional when handling upset or frustrated customers

  • Strong written communication skills and willingness to learn new software

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Shows up ready to work and follows through on commitments

  • Takes pride in quality work and attention to detail

  • Communicates clearly and professionally with customers and teammates

  • Works safely and follows established processes

  • Takes ownership, solves problems, and is willing to keep learning

  • Helps create a positive customer experience with every interaction

 

Join Our Team!

If you’re organized, customer-focused, and enjoy being part of a team that values your contributions, we’d love to hear from you. Join Sila Boston and build a career where your work makes a difference!

Customer Service Representative

JSP Home Services | Kingston, NY

Be the Voice Customers Remember

When a customer calls JSP Home Services, the person who answers the phone sets the tone for their entire experience.

We’re looking for an experienced Customer Service Representative who can handle a high volume of calls, listen carefully, solve problems, and turn customer needs into accurately booked appointments. This role is ideal for someone who is calm under pressure, naturally helpful, and confident guiding conversations toward the right next step.

At JSP Home Services, great customer service means more than answering the phone. It means making customers feel heard, capturing the right information, coordinating service accurately, and creating a positive experience from the very first interaction.

Why Join JSP Home Services?

  • Competitive compensation
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Ongoing Training and Professional Development
  • Career Growth Opportunities
  • Year-Round, Stable Employment
  • Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment
  • On-Site Position in Kingston, NY

As a Customer Service Representative, you’ll serve as the first point of contact for customers calling about plumbing, heating, cooling, electrical, and other home service needs. You’ll answer inbound calls, identify the customer’s needs, accurately schedule appointments, and help ensure each call results in a clear and positive next step.

You’ll also support outbound customer communication, including appointment confirmations, follow-up calls, membership renewals, unsold estimate follow-up, and customer satisfaction calls.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer a high volume of inbound customer calls with a friendly, professional phone presence.
  • Listen carefully, ask the right questions, and accurately identify each customer’s service needs.
  • Book, confirm, reschedule, and cancel appointments while capturing complete and accurate customer information.
  • Communicate appointment expectations, service availability, and next steps clearly.
  • De-escalate upset or stressed customers and work toward a positive resolution.
  • Overcome booking objections and help customers understand the value of scheduling service.
  • Promote maintenance plans, memberships, and available service options when appropriate.
  • Make outbound calls for appointment confirmations, customer follow-up, happy calls, membership renewals, and unsold estimates.
  • Maintain accurate customer records and call notes within the company’s scheduling and CRM systems.
  • Coordinate closely with dispatchers, technicians, and other team members to support an efficient customer experience.
  • Meet individual and team expectations for booking rates, call quality, accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain reliable attendance and punctuality for this on-site position.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of customer service experience in a phone-heavy environment, such as a call center, dispatch office, front office, or service-based business.
  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
  • Comfortable managing high call volume while remaining friendly, focused, and professional.
  • Ability to book and manage appointments accurately while capturing complete customer information.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain composed with upset or frustrated customers.
  • Basic computer proficiency and the ability to learn scheduling and CRM software quickly.
  • Reliable attendance and the ability to work on-site in Kingston, NY.
  • Prior experience in home services, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, or another trade-related business is a plus.
  • Experience with ServiceTitan or a comparable field service management platform is preferred.
  • Experience with outbound calling, customer follow-up, membership renewals, or unsold estimate rehash is preferred.
  • Sales-minded and comfortable overcoming objections and promoting memberships or maintenance plans.

Be the Voice Customers Remember

This role is ideal for someone who is calm under pressure, naturally helpful, and confident guiding conversations toward the right next step.

At JSP Home Services, great customer service means more than answering the phone. It means making customers feel heard, capturing the right information, coordinating service accurately, and creating a positive experience from the very first interaction.

Why Join JSP Home Services?

  • Competitive compensation
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Ongoing Training and Professional Development
  • Career Growth Opportunities
  • Year-Round, Stable Employment
  • Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment
  • On-Site Position in Kingston, NY

As a Customer Service Representative, you’ll serve as the first point of contact for customers calling about plumbing, heating, cooling, electrical, and other home service needs. You’ll answer inbound calls, identify the customer’s needs, accurately schedule appointments, and help ensure each call results in a clear and positive next step.

You’ll also support outbound customer communication, including appointment confirmations, follow-up calls, membership renewals, unsold estimate follow-up, and customer satisfaction calls.

  • Answer a high volume of inbound customer calls with a friendly, professional phone presence.

  • Make outbound calls for appointment confirmations, customer follow-up, happy calls, membership renewals, and unsold estimates.
  • Maintain accurate customer records and call notes within the company’s scheduling and CRM systems.
  • Coordinate closely with dispatchers, technicians, and other team members to support an efficient customer experience.
  • Meet individual and team expectations for booking rates, call quality, accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain reliable attendance and punctuality for this on-site position.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of customer service experience in a phone-heavy environment, such as a call center, dispatch office, front office, or service-based business.
  • Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.
  • Comfortable managing high call volume while remaining friendly, focused, and professional.
  • Ability to book and manage appointments accurately while capturing complete customer information.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain composed with upset or frustrated customers.
  • Basic computer proficiency and the ability to learn scheduling and CRM software quickly.
  • Reliable attendance and the ability to work on-site in Kingston, NY.
  • Prior experience in home services, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, or another trade-related business is a plus.
  • Experience with ServiceTitan or a comparable field service management platform is preferred.
  • Experience with outbound calling, customer follow-up, membership renewals, or unsold estimate rehash is preferred.
  • Sales-minded and comfortable overcoming objections and promoting memberships or maintenance plans.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means customers feel heard, appointments are booked accurately, and every conversation moves toward a helpful resolution. You’ll build trust over the phone, support the field team with complete information, and help JSP Home Services deliver a smooth and professional customer experience from the first call through the completed service.

  • Ability to multitask across multiple systems while maintaining accuracy.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle objections or difficult conversations professionally.

  • Comfortable making both inbound and outbound customer calls.

  • Organized, dependable, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Positive, team-oriented attitude and willingness to help where needed.

  • Comfortable using computers, CRM systems, scheduling software, and other business applications.

  • Home services or ServiceTitan experience is a plus, but not required.

What Success Looks Like

Success means customers feel taken care of, calls turn into appointments, schedules stay productive, and important details don't get missed.

You'll be expected to communicate professionally, take ownership of customer needs, maintain accurate information, and work closely with the rest of the team to provide a smooth experience from the first phone call through the technician's visit.

If you're looking for a customer service position where your performance matters and you can grow your career, we want to hear from you.

Director of Fleet Management | Sila Services

Location: King of Prussia, PA (Hybrid: 3 days in-office)
Reports To: Vice President of Procurement
Department: Finance
Travel: Up to 25% (OpCo site visits, OEM and upfitter meetings, vendor QBRs)

Sila Services is the fastest-growing home services platform in the Northeast, Mid-Atlantic, and Midwest, uniting 40+ HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and sewer/drain companies under a technician-first operating model. Sila operates a fleet of nearly 3,000 vehicles to serve customers across multiple states and trades, and is building centralized functions to unlock national scale while preserving local service excellence.

This leadership hire will own Sila’s fleet strategy and operations and drive meaningful change in how fleet is managed across the organization. This position will be accountable for a fleet of nearly 3,000 service vehicles, along with the related spend on vehicle acquisition and leasing, fuel, maintenance and repair, insurance-related costs, and upfit. This position will build the standards, systems, and vendor partnerships that reduce total cost of ownership, improve vehicle uptime and safety, and keep technicians productive across 40+ decentralized operating companies.

Initially a hands-on individual contributor, this role will focus on building and leading a small, high-performing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and earning respect across Sila Services.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and paid holidays

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance

  • Paid training and professional development

  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build and lead a high-performing fleet management function, including fleet operations, vendor management, and analytics, to support Sila’s multi-state, multi-trade operating model.

  • Develop and execute an enterprise fleet strategy that standardizes vehicle specifications, acquisition, upfit, maintenance, and disposal practices across all current and future OpCo’s.

  • Own the full vehicle lifecycle for a fleet of nearly 3,000 vehicles, including acquisition, financing and leasing structures, replacement cycles, and remarketing, to minimize total cost of ownership.

  • Partner with OpCo general managers, operations leaders, and technicians to understand field requirements and ensure vehicles are available, reliable, and properly equipped for each trade (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and sewer/drain).

  • Partner with Procurement to lead sourcing and contract negotiations with OEMs, dealers, upfitters, leasing companies, fuel card providers, telematics providers, and maintenance and repair vendors in collaboration with Procurement and Legal.

  • Establish enterprise fleet policies and operating standards covering vehicle assignment, take-home usage, preventive maintenance, fueling, and driver accountability, and drive adoption across decentralized OpCo’s.

  • Deploy and optimize telematics and fleet management technology to improve visibility into utilization, idling, fuel consumption, routing, driver behavior, and maintenance needs.

  • Partner with Director of Safety and Risk to build and manage a fleet safety and compliance program, including DOT and FMCSA requirements, driver qualification, MVR reviews, registrations, inspections, and accident prevention training.

  • Partner with Risk, Insurance, and HR to reduce accident frequency, claims severity, and insurance costs through data-driven safety initiatives and effective claims management.

  • Reduce vehicle downtime and maintenance costs through preventive maintenance programs, preferred repair networks, and parts and tire strategies.

  • Lead fleet due diligence and integration for acquired companies, including fleet assessment, rationalization, and transition to Sila standards and vendors.

  • Collaborate with Finance and Accounting to manage fleet budgets, forecasting, capital planning, and cost allocation, leveraging ServiceTitan and Intacct to enable accurate vehicle-level cost reporting.

  • Develop and report on fleet KPIs, including cost per mile, total cost of ownership, utilization, downtime, fuel efficiency, and accident rates, to executive leadership.

  • Continuously evaluate and improve fleet tools, processes, scorecards, and metrics.

  • Additional ad-hoc responsibilities will be needed as the program grows and matures, list above is not exhaustive.

 

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Business, or related field

  • 10+ years of fleet management experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role

  • Proven track record managing large, geographically dispersed fleets (1,000+ vehicles) and driving measurable cost and operational improvements.

  • Hands-on experience with fleet management and telematics platforms, lease and financing structures, and OEM and vendor negotiations.

  • Strong working knowledge of DOT and state-level vehicle compliance requirements and fleet safety programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Masters in Business Administration

  • CAFM (Certified Automotive Fleet Manager) or CPSM certification

  • Prior role at a multi-location field service organization, or consulting firm with a fleet focus.

  • Experience integrating acquired fleets in a private equity backed or M&A-driven environment.

 

Join Our Team!

Join Sila Services and help shape the future of fleet management across our growing organization. Apply today to be part of a team committed to operational excellence, continuous improvement, and long-term success!

Dispatcher

Jones Services – Goshen, NY

Great dispatchers do more than fill a schedule. They keep technicians productive, customers informed, and the entire service operation moving.

Jones Services is looking for a Dispatcher to join our team in Goshen, NY. This is a fast-paced role where you’ll coordinate our field technicians throughout the day, prioritize incoming service needs, adjust schedules when things change, and help make sure we’re putting the right technician in front of the right customer at the right time.

If you’re highly organized, comfortable making decisions, and can stay calm when the schedule changes unexpectedly, this could be a great opportunity for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage and continuously monitor the daily dispatch board for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical service technicians

  • Dispatch technicians to service calls based on skill set, location, availability, priority, and customer needs

  • Maintain an efficient schedule that helps maximize technician productivity and minimizes unnecessary drive time

  • Monitor technician progress throughout the day and proactively adjust the schedule when jobs run long, cancellations occur, or emergency calls come in

  • Communicate clearly with technicians regarding schedules, job information, changes, and next assignments

  • Work closely with Customer Service Representatives to coordinate newly booked calls and scheduling needs

  • Keep customers informed of technician arrival windows, delays, or changes to their appointments

  • Identify open schedule capacity and work with the team to help fill available appointment opportunities

  • Prioritize urgent service needs while balancing previously scheduled customers

  • Review upcoming calls to ensure technicians are appropriately matched to the work being performed

  • Maintain accurate customer, technician, and appointment information in the scheduling system

  • Follow up with technicians when additional information, job status updates, or next-step decisions are needed

  • Help ensure completed calls are properly closed out and technicians are ready for their next assignment

  • Communicate scheduling challenges, capacity concerns, and service issues to leadership

  • Partner with field leadership and customer service to help provide an outstanding experience from the initial call through completion of service

  • Remain flexible and solution-oriented as priorities change throughout the day

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous dispatching, scheduling, customer service, call center, or service coordination experience preferred

  • Experience dispatching technicians in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, home services, or another field-service environment is strongly preferred

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills

  • Ability to make decisions quickly while balancing multiple priorities

  • Comfortable managing a high volume of activity in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Confident communicating with both customers and field technicians

  • Ability to remain calm and professional when schedules change or problems arise

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate information

  • Ability to anticipate problems instead of waiting for them to happen

  • Team-oriented mindset with a willingness to communicate and collaborate across departments

  • Experience with ServiceTitan or another field-service management platform is a plus

What Makes a Great Jones Services Dispatcher?

  • You don’t simply wait for someone to tell you what to do next.
  • You’re watching the schedule, anticipating where problems may occur, communicating before someone has to ask, and constantly looking for the best way to keep the day moving.
  • You understand that an open technician slot can mean a missed opportunity, a poorly matched call can hurt both the technician and the customer experience, and a lack of communication can quickly create frustration.
  • Successful Dispatchers take ownership of the board and treat the success of the service day as their responsibility.

Why Join Jones Services?

At Jones Services, our focus is on providing a best-in-class workplace while delivering world-class service to our customers.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage to help protect you and your family.
  • 401(k) with Company Match: Build toward your long-term financial goals with company-supported retirement savings.
  • Paid Time Off & Paid Holidays: Take time away from work to recharge and enjoy life outside of the office.
  • Training & Development: We believe in developing our people and providing opportunities to build new skills and grow professionally.
  • Career Growth: As our organization continues to grow, strong performers have opportunities to take on additional responsibility and advance their careers.
  • Supportive Team Environment: Work alongside customer service, field leadership, technicians, and other team members focused on helping one another succeed.

About Jones Services

Jones Services provides heating, cooling, plumbing, and electrical services to homeowners throughout the Hudson Valley and surrounding communities.

Our customers depend on us when something in their home isn’t working, and our Dispatch team plays a critical role in making sure help gets to them efficiently.

If you’re organized, proactive, comfortable making decisions, and enjoy being at the center of a fast-moving operation, we want to hear from you.

Apply today to join Jones Services as a Dispatcher.

    Carter's Plumbing, Heating & Cooling | Detroit, MI

    ** Please do not apply if you do not have Drain Cleaning experience**

    Drain Technician

    Sila Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric | King of Prussia, PA

    Build Your Career with a Team That Keeps You Moving

    At Sila Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric, our Drain Technicians play an important role in helping homeowners solve some of the most urgent and disruptive problems in their homes.

    We’re looking for a Drain Technician who is dependable, mechanically inclined, comfortable working in customers’ homes, and motivated to build a long-term career in the plumbing and home services industry.

    You’ll have steady customer demand, support from experienced plumbing professionals, strong dispatch and customer service teams, and access to the tools and training needed to grow your skills.

    Whether you already have drain-cleaning experience or are looking to build on your plumbing background, this is an opportunity to join a professional team where strong performance, customer service, and continued development matter.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose and clear residential drain and sewer stoppages.
    • Use drain-cleaning equipment, cable machines, augers, and other appropriate tools.
    • Perform camera inspections to help identify blockages, damaged piping, root intrusion, and other drainage issues.
    • Explain findings and recommended next steps clearly to homeowners.
    • Identify situations that may require additional plumbing repairs, excavation, hydro jetting, or sewer-line replacement.
    • Maintain a clean and professional work area while protecting the customer’s home.
    • Complete accurate service notes, photos, and job documentation.
    • Maintain assigned tools, equipment, vehicle, and drain-cleaning inventory.
    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, plumbers, and other field team members.
    • Follow company safety procedures and proper equipment-use practices.
    • Participate in technical training, team meetings, and professional development.
    • Provide a professional customer experience from arrival through job completion.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous drain-cleaning, plumbing, maintenance, or mechanical experience preferred.
    • Comfortable working with drain-cleaning and sewer equipment.
    • Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
    • Ability to communicate professionally with homeowners.
    • Willingness to learn and continue developing plumbing and drain-service skills.
    • Ability to work independently while knowing when to involve a senior plumber or supervisor.
    • Dependable, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced service environment.
    • Ability to perform physical work in basements, crawl spaces, utility areas, and outdoor conditions.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    Why Work at Sila?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities
    • Steady, year-round customer demand
    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support
    • Fully stocked warehouse and parts support
    • Company-provided vehicle, tools, and equipment as applicable
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • Paid Time Off
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Paid parental leave
    • Ongoing technical and customer service training
    • Career advancement opportunities within plumbing and home services
    • Opportunity to develop into more advanced drain, sewer, or plumbing roles
    • Support from an experienced field and operations team

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means solving drain problems safely and efficiently, communicating clearly with customers, and knowing when an issue requires a more advanced plumbing solution.

    You’ll keep your equipment and vehicle organized, document your work thoroughly, and help customers understand what is happening with their plumbing system.

    Most importantly, you’ll provide dependable service while continuing to build the skills needed to grow your career with Sila.

    Solve Problems Customers Need Fixed Now

    We’re looking for a dependable, mechanically inclined Drain Technician who is comfortable working in customers’ homes, operating professional drain equipment, and communicating clearly about what they find.

    Whether you already have drain-cleaning experience or are building your career within plumbing, Davis offers the support, training, and opportunity to continue developing your skills.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose and clear residential drain and sewer stoppages.
    • Operate cable machines, augers, drain-cleaning equipment, and related tools.
    • Perform sewer-camera inspections and identify blockages, root intrusion, damaged piping, and other drainage issues.
    • Explain findings and recommended next steps clearly to homeowners.
    • Identify when issues require additional plumbing repair, excavation, jetting, or sewer-line replacement.
    • Complete accurate service notes, photos, and job documentation.
    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.
    • Maintain drain-cleaning equipment, tools, vehicle, and inventory.
    • Coordinate with dispatch, plumbers, customer service, and other field teams.
    • Follow company safety procedures and proper equipment-use practices.
    • Participate in technical and customer-service training.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous drain-cleaning, plumbing, maintenance, or mechanical experience preferred.
    • Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
    • Comfortable using drain-cleaning and sewer-inspection equipment.
    • Strong customer service and communication skills.
    • Ability to work independently while knowing when to involve a plumber or supervisor.
    • Dependable, organized, and comfortable working in basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.
    • Willingness to learn and continue developing plumbing and drain-service skills.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    Why Work at Davis?

    • Competitive compensation and advancement opportunities
    • Steady residential customer demand
    • Opportunity to grow into advanced drain, sewer, and plumbing work
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • Retirement Plan with Company Match
    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
    • Company Vehicle for qualified field roles
    • Tool Account Program
    • Uniforms and major equipment provided
    • Ongoing technical training and professional development
    • Supportive, team-oriented work environment

    What Success Looks Like

    Success means clearing drain problems efficiently, identifying the real cause of the issue, communicating professionally with the homeowner, and knowing when a more advanced plumbing solution is needed.

    You’ll be expected to take care of the customer, maintain your equipment, and continue building your technical skills.

    Burns & McBride | New Castle, DE

    Pay: $30 - $35/hr plus uncapped commissions and bonuses

    Help Build the Next Part of Our Business

    Burns & McBride is growing, and we’re looking for our first dedicated Drain & Sewer Technician to help launch and build this new service line.

    This is more than another service truck. It’s an opportunity to help build something from the ground up within a growing home services company.

    Why Join Burns & McBride?

    We don't just offer jobs—we build careers. Here’s why you’ll love being part of our team:

    • Industry-Leading Compensation: We believe in rewarding excellence, which is why we offer compensation that provides six-figure earning potential!
    • Fully Stocked Warehouse with Parts Runners
    • Clean, Fully Stocked Truck
    • Comprehensive Health Benefits: We offer affordable, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family covered.
    • Paid Time Off
    • 401(k) Plan with Company Match
    • Parental Leave: We support our team members through all stages of life, including offering parental leave for new parents.
    • Training and Development Opportunities: We’re committed to your professional growth and provide ongoing training.
    • Yearly Performance Reviews: We believe in continuous improvement and offer yearly performance reviews to ensure you’re on track and rewarded for your hard work.
    • Opportunity to Help Build the Department: Join as our first dedicated Drain & Sewer Technician and help shape the future of this growing service line.

    What You’ll Do

    • Perform residential drain cleaning, clearing, cabling, and hydro-jetting.
    • Diagnose drain and sewer issues throughout the home and from the home to the curb.
    • Operate small- and large-sized drain machines and sewer camera equipment.
    • Identify blockages, damaged piping, root intrusion, and other drain or sewer concerns.
    • Recommend appropriate repair, replacement, or additional service options.
    • Explain findings and solutions clearly to homeowners.
    • Present estimates and obtain customer approval before completing work.
    • Identify additional drain or plumbing solutions that meet customer needs.
    • Perform related plumbing service work when qualified, including removing and resetting toilets and P-traps.
    • Complete accurate service notes, photos, estimates, and customer documentation.
    • Maintain truck inventory, tools, and equipment.
    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.
    • Communicate effectively with customers, office staff, and other field team members.
    • Participate in technical training, team meetings, and ongoing professional development.

    What We’re Looking For

    • 5+ years of hands-on drain-clearing experience
    • Strong residential drain and sewer diagnostic skills.
    • Experience working on systems from inside the home to the curb.
    • Experience with cable machines, hydro-jetting equipment, and sewer cameras.
    • Proven ability to explain recommendations and sell appropriate drain and sewer services.
    • Strong customer service and communication skills.
    • Solid understanding of residential plumbing and drain systems.
    • Residential service plumbing experience is a strong plus.
    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.
    • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile apps, and field service software. Service Titan experience a plus!
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
    • Ability to perform physical work in basements, crawl spaces, bathrooms, and outdoor environments.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means becoming the person Burns & McBride can rely on for drain and sewer work.

    You’ll diagnose problems accurately, provide dependable solutions, take care of customers, and help establish the standards and processes that support the department as it grows.

    Because you’ll be our first dedicated Drain & Sewer Technician, there’s real opportunity to make an impact today and grow into more as the business develops.

    Levine & Sons

    Love working with your hands? Like seeing the results of your work at the end of the day? Join the team at Levine & Sons!

    We're looking for a Drain & Sewer Installer who takes pride in quality workmanship and wants to be part of a team that works hard, supports one another, and gets the job done right. Whether you're replacing sewer lines, installing cleanouts, or operating equipment, you'll play a key role in helping homeowners solve some of their biggest plumbing problems.

    If you're dependable, mechanically inclined, and enjoy working outdoors, we'd love to talk to you!

    What You'll Do

    • Install and replace residential sewer and drain lines
    • Perform sewer excavations and underground plumbing work
    • Install cleanouts, sewer mains, water service lines, and drain piping
    • Repair or replace cast iron, PVC, SDR, and Schedule 40 piping
    • Assist with excavation, trenching, and site restoration
    • Safely operate or assist with mini excavators, skid steers, trenching equipment, and other job site tools
    • Read measurements and ensure proper pipe pitch and drainage
    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe job site
    • Communicate professionally with homeowners and teammates

    What We're Looking For

    • 2+ years of residential drain and sewer installation experience
    • Experience with sewer line replacements, excavations, and underground plumbing
    • Knowledge of PVC, SDR, cast iron, and drain piping systems
    • Mechanical aptitude and strong problem-solving skills
    • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions
    • Ability to lift 50+ pounds and perform physically demanding work
    • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
    • Ability to pass a background check
    • Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and team-first mentality

    What You'll Get

    • Competitive pay based on experience
    • Full-time, year-round work
    • Overtime opportunities
    • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
    • Paid Time Off and holidays
    • 401(k) with company match
    • Ongoing training and opportunities for advancement
    • Company that values hard work, teamwork, and doing the job right

    Why Levine & Sons?

    At Levine & Sons, we know our people are what make us successful. We're looking for someone who wants more than just a job—someone who wants to build a career with a company that invests in its team, supports growth, and takes pride in delivering outstanding service to every customer.

    If you're ready to dig in and build a long-term career, apply today and join the Levine & Sons team!

    Residential Service Electrician

    JSP Home Services | Kingston, NY

    Experienced electricians have options. The right opportunity should offer more than a full schedule—it should provide steady customer demand, strong office support, quality tools, continued training, and a company that respects the expertise you bring into every home.

    At JSP Home Services, we’re looking for an experienced Residential Service Electrician who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, safe workmanship, and creating a professional customer experience. You’ll have the support of a knowledgeable dispatch and operations team, the resources needed to work efficiently, and opportunities to continue growing your skills and earning potential.

    As a Residential Service Electrician, you’ll diagnose, repair, and improve residential electrical systems while helping homeowners understand their options and make informed decisions about the safety and reliability of their homes.

    If you’re looking for year-round work, strong operational support, and a company that values quality, accountability, and doing the job right, JSP Home Services may be the right place for your next move.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential electrical systems.

    • Install and replace panels, breakers, circuits, outlets, switches, lighting, ceiling fans, and other electrical components.

    • Complete service upgrades, wiring repairs, dedicated circuits, and electrical system improvements.

    • Install EV chargers, generators, surge protection, smoke detectors, and other residential electrical equipment.

    • Perform electrical safety inspections and identify code, safety, or performance concerns.

    • Clearly explain findings and recommend appropriate repair or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and follow-up documentation.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, materials, and truck inventory.

    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, and other field teams.

    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential electrical service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Knowledge of residential wiring methods, electrical systems, and the National Electrical Code.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.

    • Comfortable presenting service options and making appropriate recommendations.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work.

    • New York electrical license or applicable local credentials preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Work at JSP Home Services?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Vehicle

    • Company Tablet

    • Uniforms and Professional Tools

    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Customer Service Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Support from an experienced plumbing, HVAC, and electrical team

    • A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing electrical problems accurately, completing safe and dependable work, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll communicate professionally, document your work thoroughly, and help JSP Home Services continue earning customer trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.

    Residential Service Electrician

    JSP Home Services | Kingston, NY

    Experienced electricians have options. The right opportunity should offer more than a full schedule—it should provide steady customer demand, strong office support, quality tools, continued training, and a company that respects the expertise you bring into every home.

    At JSP Home Services, we’re looking for an experienced Residential Service Electrician who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, safe workmanship, and creating a professional customer experience. You’ll have the support of a knowledgeable dispatch and operations team, the resources needed to work efficiently, and opportunities to continue growing your skills and earning potential.

    As a Residential Service Electrician, you’ll diagnose, repair, and improve residential electrical systems while helping homeowners understand their options and make informed decisions about the safety and reliability of their homes.

    If you’re looking for year-round work, strong operational support, and a company that values quality, accountability, and doing the job right, JSP Home Services may be the right place for your next move.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential electrical systems.

    • Install and replace panels, breakers, circuits, outlets, switches, lighting, ceiling fans, and other electrical components.

    • Complete service upgrades, wiring repairs, dedicated circuits, and electrical system improvements.

    • Install EV chargers, generators, surge protection, smoke detectors, and other residential electrical equipment.

    • Perform electrical safety inspections and identify code, safety, or performance concerns.

    • Clearly explain findings and recommend appropriate repair or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and follow-up documentation.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, materials, and truck inventory.

    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, and other field teams.

    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential electrical service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Knowledge of residential wiring methods, electrical systems, and the National Electrical Code.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.

    • Comfortable presenting service options and making appropriate recommendations.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work.

    • New York electrical license or applicable local credentials preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Work at JSP Home Services?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Vehicle

    • Company Tablet

    • Uniforms and Professional Tools

    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Customer Service Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Support from an experienced plumbing, HVAC, and electrical team

    • A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing electrical problems accurately, completing safe and dependable work, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll communicate professionally, document your work thoroughly, and help JSP Home Services continue earning customer trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.
