    Residential Service Electrician

    Gary & Sons has been serving homeowners throughout the region since 1978. Our reputation is built on skilled professionals who take pride in dependable workmanship, honest communication, and treating every customer the right way. We're committed to supporting our employees and providing the tools, training, and opportunities they need to succeed.

    We're looking for an experienced Residential Service Electrician to join our team! This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys troubleshooting, solving problems, and providing homeowners with safe, reliable electrical solutions. You'll handle a variety of residential service, repair, maintenance, and installation work while delivering the quality workmanship and customer experience Gary & Sons is known for.

    Benefits

    • Competitive Compensation: $50,000 - $60,000/year with weekly pay!

    • Company-provided phone/tablet (for eligible field positions)

    • Tool and safety equipment support

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

    • 401(k) with company match

    • Paid time off and paid holidays

    • Company-paid life and disability insurance

    • Paid training and professional development

    • Opportunities for career growth and advancement

     

    What You'll Do

    • Diagnose and repair residential electrical problems.

    • Perform electrical service, maintenance, repairs, and installations.

    • Install and replace panels, breakers, outlets, switches, fixtures, fans, and other electrical components.

    • Troubleshoot wiring, circuits, controls, and electrical systems.

    • Perform electrical upgrades and code corrections.

    • Present repair and replacement options clearly to homeowners.

    • Complete estimates, invoices, and job documentation.

    • Maintain a clean and organized company vehicle and work area.

    • Follow NEC, local codes, safety procedures, and company standards.

    • Provide excellent customer service on every call.

     

    What We're Looking For

    • 3 - 5 years of residential electrical service experience.

    • Experience with panel change outs, electric repairs, wiring, generators, etc

    • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.

    • Knowledge of residential electrical systems and current electrical codes.

    • Ability to read wiring diagrams and use electrical testing equipment.

    • Strong customer communication skills.

    • Comfortable presenting solutions and options to homeowners.

    • Applicable electrical license required based on state and local regulations.

    • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Field service software experience is a plus.

     

    What Success Looks Like

    • Shows up ready to work and follows through on commitments.

    • Takes pride in quality workmanship and attention to detail.

    • Communicates clearly with customers and teammates.

    • Works safely and follows established processes.

    • Takes ownership, solves problems, and is willing to keep learning.

     

    Join Our Team!

    If you're an experienced electrician who takes pride in quality work, enjoys helping homeowners, and wants to be part of a team that values honesty and craftsmanship, we'd love to hear from you. Join Gary & Sons and help us continue delivering dependable service to our community!

    About Dave's World

    Dave's World is one of Maine's leading home services companies, known for our expertise in heat pumps, heating and cooling, plumbing, electrical, and energy-efficient home solutions. With seven locations across Maine, we've built our reputation on quality workmanship, exceptional customer service, and taking care of our employees.

    As part of the Sila Services family, we have the resources and support of a growing organization while maintaining the local relationships and culture that have made Dave's World successful.

    About the Opportunity

    We're looking for an experienced, hands-on General Manager to lead our operations across Maine. This is an opportunity for a strong business leader who knows how to grow a company, develop people, improve processes, and drive profitability.

    The right person will have experience managing a multi-location operation, understand the financial side of running a business, and be comfortable working closely with sales, service, installation, and support teams.

    We're looking for someone who can balance big-picture strategy with day-to-day execution, hold teams accountable, and build on the success Dave's World has already established.

    What You'll Be Responsible For

    Business Operations & Financial Performance

    • Take ownership of overall business performance, including revenue, profitability, budgets, and P&L management.

    • Develop and execute strategies to drive revenue growth, improve margins, and increase operational efficiency.

    • Monitor key performance indicators, including revenue, gross margin, labor efficiency, average ticket, close rates, and customer satisfaction.

    • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, control costs, and improve productivity.

    • Oversee daily operations across multiple locations, ensuring consistency, quality, and accountability.

    • Work closely with regional and corporate leadership on business planning, forecasting, and long-term growth initiatives.

    Sales & Business Growth

    • Partner with sales leadership to drive performance, improve conversion rates, and maximize revenue opportunities.

    • Identify opportunities to expand services, increase market share, and grow existing customer relationships.

    • Ensure sales and operational teams are aligned on customer expectations, scheduling, and execution.

    • Monitor lead conversion, sales performance, and installation capacity to support sustainable growth.

    • Build a culture focused on delivering solutions that meet customer needs rather than high-pressure sales tactics.

    Team Leadership & Development

    • Lead, coach, and develop managers across sales, service, installation, and operations.

    • Establish clear expectations, measurable goals, and accountability throughout the organization.

    • Build a strong leadership team capable of supporting continued growth.

    • Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR on staffing, retention, succession planning, and employee development.

    • Foster a positive, performance-driven culture where employees feel supported and have opportunities to grow.

    • Maintain strong communication and collaboration across all locations.

    Customer Experience & Operational Excellence

    • Ensure customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience from their initial inquiry through project completion.

    • Oversee service delivery, installation quality, scheduling efficiency, and workforce utilization.

    • Address operational challenges proactively and implement solutions that improve performance.

    • Ensure compliance with safety standards, licensing requirements, and company policies.

    • Maintain the reputation and local relationships that have made Dave's World a trusted name throughout Maine.

    What We're Looking For

    • 7–10+ years of progressive leadership experience, preferably within HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or residential home services.

    • Experience managing multiple locations, branches, or a geographically dispersed operation.

    • Strong financial acumen with demonstrated P&L ownership and experience managing budgets, revenue, and profitability.

    • Proven ability to grow revenue, improve operational performance, and develop successful teams.

    • Experience leading sales, service, installation, and operational functions.

    • Strong understanding of KPIs, labor management, scheduling, capacity planning, and operational efficiency.

    • Ability to lead through change while maintaining employee engagement and a strong company culture.

    • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills.

    • Familiarity with ServiceTitan or similar field service management platforms is a plus.

    • HVAC or home services industry experience strongly preferred; technical trade experience is helpful but not required.

    • Ability to travel between Dave's World locations throughout Maine.

    What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

    We're looking for a leader who takes ownership of the business and treats it like their own. Someone who understands the numbers but also knows that the people behind those numbers are what make a company successful.

    You'll be successful if you can build strong relationships with your teams, identify opportunities for improvement, make sound business decisions, and create an environment where employees and customers want to stay.

    This isn't a position for someone who wants to manage strictly from behind a desk. We want someone who is visible, engaged, approachable, and willing to roll up their sleeves when needed.

    Why Join Dave's World?

    At Dave's World, you'll have the opportunity to lead an established and respected Maine business while helping shape its next chapter of growth. You'll work alongside experienced teams, have access to the resources of Sila Services, and play a meaningful role in building a stronger business for our employees and customers.

    If you're a proven leader who enjoys developing people, improving operations, and driving results, we'd love to hear from you.

    • Partner with sales leadership to drive performance, improve conversion rates, and maximize revenue opportunities.

    • Identify opportunities to expand services, increase market share, and grow existing customer relationships.

    • Ensure sales and operational teams are aligned on customer expectations, scheduling, and execution.

    • Monitor lead conversion, sales performance, and installation capacity to support sustainable growth.

    • Lead, coach, and develop managers across sales, service, installation, and operations.

    • Establish clear expectations, measurable goals, and accountability throughout the organization.

    • Build a strong leadership team capable of supporting continued growth.

    • Ensure customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience from their initial inquiry through project completion.

    • Oversee service delivery, installation quality, scheduling efficiency, and workforce utilization.

    • Address operational challenges proactively and implement solutions that improve performance.

    • Ensure compliance with safety standards, licensing requirements, and company policies.

    • Maintain the reputation and local relationships that have made Dave's World a trusted name throughout Maine.

    What We're Looking For

    • 7–10+ years of progressive leadership experience, preferably within HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or residential home services.

    • Experience managing multiple locations, branches, or a geographically dispersed operation.

    • Strong financial acumen with demonstrated P&L ownership and experience managing budgets, revenue, and profitability.

    • Proven ability to grow revenue, improve operational performance, and develop successful teams.

    • Experience leading sales, service, installation, and operational functions.

    • Strong understanding of KPIs, labor management, scheduling, capacity planning, and operational efficiency.

    • Ability to lead through change while maintaining employee engagement and a strong company culture.

    • Familiarity with ServiceTitan or similar field service management platforms is a plus.

    • HVAC or home services industry experience strongly preferred; technical trade experience is helpful but not required.

    • Ability to travel between Dave's World locations throughout Maine.

    What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

    We're looking for a leader who takes ownership of the business and treats it like their own. Someone who understands the numbers but also knows that the people behind those numbers are what make a company successful.

    You'll be successful if you can build strong relationships with your teams, identify opportunities for improvement, make sound business decisions, and create an environment where employees and customers want to stay.

    This isn't a position for someone who wants to manage strictly from behind a desk. We want someone who is visible, engaged, approachable, and willing to roll up their sleeves when needed.

    Why Join Dave's World?

    At Dave's World, you'll have the opportunity to lead an established and respected Maine business while helping shape its next chapter of growth. You'll work alongside experienced teams, have access to the resources of Sila Services, and play a meaningful role in building a stronger business for our employees and customers.

    If you're a proven leader who enjoys developing people, improving operations, and driving results, we'd love to hear from you.

    HR Coordinator

    My Plumber Plus | Manassas, VA

    Pay: $55,000–$67,000 annually

     

    About My Plumber Plus

    Since 1982, My Plumber Plus has served homeowners throughout Northern Virginia and Suburban Maryland with trusted plumbing, HVAC, electrical, and drain services. What began as a small local plumbing company has grown into one of the region’s leading residential home-service providers.

    As part of the Sila Services family of companies, My Plumber Plus combines the reputation and culture of an established local brand with the resources, training, and career opportunities of a growing home-services organization. Our success is built on talented people who take pride in their work, support one another, and deliver an exceptional experience to every customer.

     

    About the Role

    My Plumber Plus is looking for an HR Coordinator to support employees and leaders at our Manassas location and across other Sila Services operations in the DMV region.

    This is a hands-on, in-person HR role for someone who enjoys staying close to the business, solving problems, supporting employees, and keeping important processes organized and moving forward. You’ll serve as a local HR resource for field and office teams while partnering closely with Corporate HR, Payroll, Benefits, Legal, Safety, and Talent Acquisition.

    If you’re an organized, process-oriented HR professional who communicates well, follows through on commitments, and can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, this could be a great next step in your career.

     

    What You’ll Do

    Employee Relations and HR Support

    • Support day-to-day employee relations matters involving local field and office teams.
    • Coordinate employee offboarding and termination processing.
    • Conduct exit interviews and help identify recurring themes or trends.
    • Provide onsite support for employee investigations in partnership with Corporate HR.
    • Serve as a trusted local resource for employees and managers.
    • Escalate complex employee matters to the appropriate Corporate HR or Legal partner.

    HR Administration and Performance

    • Maintain accurate and confidential employee records in ADP.
    • Coordinate and track 30-, 60-, and 90-day performance reviews.
    • Ensure required HR documentation is completed, organized, and submitted on time.
    • Support local HR reporting, audits, and administrative projects.
    • Follow up with employees and managers to keep HR processes moving forward.

    Benefits, ADA, and Employee Support

    • Serve as a local point of contact for benefits questions and communications.
    • Partner with Corporate Benefits, HR, and Legal on employee requests and workplace accommodations.
    • Help employees understand available resources and the appropriate next steps.
    • Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.

    Safety and Compliance

    • Coordinate the local Safety Committee and monthly safety meetings.
    • Prepare safety-meeting agendas, presentations, and required documentation.
    • Maintain OSHA logs and support required reporting.
    • Assist with workplace injury investigations and incident documentation.
    • Follow up on workers’ compensation matters in coordination with Corporate HR and Safety.
    • Help ensure required safety documentation and employee training remain current.

    Hiring and Onboarding Support

    • Coordinate new-hire start dates and schedules with hiring managers and Talent Acquisition.
    • Assign and track required training through Schoox and SPARC.
    • Coordinate onboarding activities and ensure new employees complete required documentation.
    • Support the distribution and tracking of uniforms and personal protective equipment for field employees.
    • Help create an organized and welcoming onboarding experience for new team members.

    HR Programs and Communications

    • Help improve local HR processes and standard operating procedures.
    • Draft and distribute clear employee communications.
    • Coordinate employee-recognition programs, including birthdays, anniversaries, awards, and other local initiatives.
    • Assist with employee events and engagement activities.
    • Identify opportunities to improve organization, communication, and follow-through across local HR processes.

     

    What We’re Looking For

    • Two to five years of experience as an HR Coordinator, HR Generalist, HR Assistant, or in a similar position.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
    • Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
    • Process-oriented mindset with the ability to identify and implement improvements.
    • Experience supporting field, service, skilled-trades, or multi-location employees is a plus.
    • Working knowledge of ADP or another HRIS platform.
    • Familiarity with OSHA recordkeeping and workers’ compensation processes is helpful, but training can be provided.
    • Experience supporting ADA accommodations is a plus, but not required.
    • Comfortable building relationships with both office employees and field technicians.
    • Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential employee information.
    • PHR or SHRM-CP certification is a plus, but not required.

     

    Work Environment

    • This is an in-office position based primarily at My Plumber Plus in Manassas, Virginia.
    • Regular local travel to other Sila Services branches throughout the DMV region may be required.
    • In-person support is required for onboarding, safety meetings, employee matters, investigations, and other HR activities.
    • The position is primarily office-based, with occasional time spent in branch shops and other operational environments.

     

    Why Join Us?

    • Take on a hands-on HR role with a direct impact on employees and local leadership.
    • Work closely with both field and office teams.
    • Gain exposure to employee relations, safety, onboarding, benefits, compliance, and HR operations.
    • Receive support from centralized HR, Payroll, Benefits, Legal, Safety, and Talent Acquisition teams.
    • Participate in ongoing training and professional development.
    • Build experience supporting multiple Sila Services locations throughout the DMV region.
    • Pursue opportunities for continued responsibility and long-term career growth.

     

    If you’re looking for an HR opportunity where you can stay close to the operation, build trusted relationships, and help keep important people processes organized and moving forward, we’d like to hear from you.

     

    Apply today

    Launch Your HVAC Career with Sullivan Super Service!

    • Positive attitude with a strong work ethic.
    • Dependable, punctual, and coachable.
    • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
    • Ability to lift 50+ pounds and work in attics, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.
    • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record.
    • EPA Certification is a plus but not required.

    Why Join Sullivan Super Service?

    • Competitive hourly pay
    • Overtime opportunities
    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
    • 401(k) with company match
    • Paid time off and paid holidays
    • Company-provided training and ongoing development
    • Career advancement opportunities
    • Supportive team environment
    • Stable, year-round work

    If you're ready to start a rewarding career in the HVAC industry with a company that invests in your future, apply today and join the Sullivan Super Service team!

    Comfort Advisor / In-Home Sales Consultant

    Levine & Sons Plumbing, Heating & Cooling | Southfield, MI

    Join Our Team!

    At Levine & Sons Plumbing, Heating & Cooling, we’ve been helping Michigan families stay comfortable since 1927. We take pride in doing great work, treating people right, and giving our team the tools, training, and support they need to succeed.

    We’re looking for a motivated, results-driven Comfort Advisor to help homeowners find the right heating and cooling solutions. Whether you’re an experienced in-home sales professional or a confident HVAC technician ready to transition into sales, this is an opportunity to grow your career and earn $100,000–$150,000+ annually.

    Compensation & Benefits

    • Competitive earning potential: $100,000–$150,000+ annually, with weekly pay!

    • Commission-based pay with bonus opportunities.

    • Company car and fuel support.

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

    • Health Savings Account (HSA).

    • 401(k) with company match.

    • Life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.

    • Paid time off and paid training.

    • Tuition reimbursement and travel reimbursement.

    • Opportunities for career growth and advancement.

    What You’ll Do

    • Meet with homeowners to evaluate their heating and cooling needs and present recommended solutions.

    • Deliver professional, engaging in-home sales presentations.

    • Build trust with customers by providing honest recommendations and exceptional service.

    • Close sales and help customers choose the best solutions for their homes.

    • Follow up consistently with customers and maintain strong relationships.

    • Work leads generated through our in-house marketing team, repeat customers, referrals, and personal prospecting.

    • Manage your schedule and sales opportunities in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment.

    What We’re Looking For

    • At least 3 years of sales experience.

    • Strong in-home presentation, communication, and closing skills.

    • Self-motivated, organized, and results-oriented, with excellent follow-through.

    • An outgoing personality and the drive to meet and exceed sales goals.

    • A customer-first mindset built on honesty, integrity, and professionalism.

    • Flexibility to meet customers on their schedules.

    • A valid driver's license.

    • HVAC experience is a plus, especially for technicians interested in transitioning into a sales career.

     

    Why Levine & Sons?

    At Levine & Sons, we believe our people are the foundation of our success. We’re proud of our long-standing reputation, commitment to customer service, and supportive team environment. If you’re ready to put your sales skills to work, build lasting customer relationships, and take control of your earning potential, we’d love to hear from you!

    Position Details

    • Job Type: Full-time, commission-based

    • Schedule: Monday–Friday

    • Location: Southfield, MI; on the road visiting customers

    Levine & Sons Plumbing, Heating & Cooling is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE M/F/D/V).

    HVAC Comfort Advisor / Outside Sales Representative

    Astar Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric | Middletown, NY

    Astar is looking for a motivated HVAC Comfort Advisor / Outside Sales Representative to meet with homeowners, understand their heating and cooling needs, and help them select the right comfort solutions for their homes.

    We’re open to several different backgrounds. You may be an experienced HVAC technician or installer who knows the equipment and is ready to move out of the tools and into sales. You may already have HVAC or mechanical sales experience. Or you may be a proven commission-based salesperson from another industry who knows how to build trust, follow a sales process, and close business.

    What matters most is that you can connect with homeowners, understand their needs, communicate solutions clearly, and are motivated by the opportunity to earn based on your performance.

    You’ll be backed by experienced service, installation, customer service, and operations teams so you can focus on providing a great customer experience and helping homeowners make confident decisions.

    What You’ll Do

    • Meet with homeowners to evaluate their heating, cooling, and indoor comfort needs.
    • Assess existing HVAC systems and understand customer priorities around comfort, efficiency, reliability, and budget.
    • Recommend appropriate HVAC replacement and upgrade options.
    • Present equipment, financing, warranties, and installation options clearly and professionally.
    • Prepare accurate proposals and estimates.
    • Help customers understand the differences between available solutions without relying on high-pressure sales tactics.
    • Follow up on open proposals and maintain consistent communication with prospective customers.
    • Build trust with homeowners and guide them through the decision-making process.
    • Coordinate sold projects with installation, customer service, and operations teams to ensure a smooth handoff.
    • Maintain accurate customer notes, proposals, and sales activity in company systems.
    • Stay current on HVAC equipment, products, promotions, financing programs, and available solutions.
    • Consistently work toward sales, conversion, and revenue goals.

    Who We’re Looking For

    We’re open to candidates from three primary backgrounds:

    • HVAC Technician or Installer ready to move into sales. You understand residential HVAC systems and enjoy working with customers. Previous sales experience is a plus, but not required.
    • Sales professional with HVAC or mechanical experience. You have experience selling within the residential or commercial HVAC, mechanical, construction, or related industries.
    • Experienced commission-based salesperson. You have 2+ years of successful sales experience, preferably in a commission, draw, or performance-based compensation environment. Automotive sales professionals and others accustomed to consultative, high-value purchases can translate well into this role.

    Regardless of background, we’re looking for someone who:

    • Communicates confidently and professionally with homeowners.
    • Builds relationships and establishes trust quickly.
    • Is comfortable asking questions, identifying needs, and recommending solutions.
    • Is motivated by goals and performance-based earnings.
    • Handles follow-up consistently rather than waiting for customers to call back.
    • Can learn HVAC products and technical concepts when needed.
    • Is organized and comfortable managing multiple opportunities at different stages of the sales process.
    • Is comfortable using CRM systems, tablets, and digital sales tools.
    • Has a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    Why Work at Astar?

    • Strong earning potential tied to performance
    • Company-generated customer opportunities
    • Steady residential demand
    • Established service and installation teams supporting the sales process
    • Opportunity for experienced HVAC technicians and installers to transition into sales
    • Training and development to help you strengthen both technical and sales skills
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
    • Company-provided technology and sales resources
    • Career advancement opportunities
    • Support from customer service, operations, technicians, and installers

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role is about more than closing a sale.

    You’ll understand what the homeowner is trying to accomplish, recommend solutions that make sense for their home and budget, communicate clearly, and follow through from the initial appointment through the handoff to installation.

    For an HVAC technician or installer, this can be an opportunity to use the technical knowledge you’ve already built in a new way and create a different career path within the industry.

    For an experienced salesperson, it’s an opportunity to bring your ability to build relationships, earn trust, and close business into an essential home-service industry with strong customer demand.

    Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric | Rocky Mount, Danville & Lynchburg, VA

    Start a Career in HVAC and Get Paid to Learn

    If you like working with your hands, solving problems, and learning a skilled trade, Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric can help you build a career in HVAC.

    We’re looking for motivated HVAC Install Apprentices who want hands-on experience, professional training, and the opportunity to learn from experienced installers in the field.

    You don’t need years of HVAC experience to get started. We’re looking for people who are dependable, mechanically inclined, willing to learn, and serious about building a long-term career.

    As an Install Apprentice, you’ll work alongside experienced HVAC installers and gradually build the skills needed to install residential heating and cooling systems safely and correctly.

    What You’ll Learn & Do

    • Assist Lead Installers with residential HVAC system replacements and new installations.
    • Help install furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, thermostats, ductwork, and related equipment.
    • Learn how to safely remove and replace HVAC equipment.
    • Assist with refrigerant lines, condensate drains, electrical connections, venting, and system components.
    • Learn how to properly use HVAC tools, testing equipment, and installation materials.
    • Help prepare equipment and materials before each installation.
    • Load and unload equipment, tools, and supplies.
    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe jobsite.
    • Protect customers’ homes while work is being completed.
    • Learn proper installation procedures, manufacturer requirements, and safety standards.
    • Assist with system startup, testing, and jobsite cleanup.
    • Maintain tools, equipment, and assigned vehicles.
    • Participate in company training and professional development.
    • Work toward certifications and advancement into higher-level HVAC installation roles.

    What We’re Looking For

    • No prior HVAC experience required; construction, mechanical, maintenance, or trade experience is a plus.
    • Strong mechanical aptitude and willingness to learn.
    • Comfortable working with hand tools and power tools.
    • Dependable and able to show up on time every day.
    • Positive attitude and willingness to take direction and accept coaching.
    • Ability to work well as part of a team.
    • Strong attention to safety and quality.
    • Comfortable working in attics, crawl spaces, basements, and outdoor conditions.
    • Ability to lift and move HVAC equipment and materials.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
    • Willingness to obtain required HVAC certifications as you progress.

    Why Start Your Career at Davis?

    • Paid, hands-on HVAC training
    • Competitive pay with opportunities to earn more as your skills grow
    • Clear path toward becoming an HVAC Installer or Lead Installer
    • Steady, year-round work
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • Life Insurance
    • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
    • 401(k) Plan
    • Paid Time Off
    • Paid Holidays
    • Ongoing technical training and professional development
    • Opportunities to earn industry certifications
    • Support from experienced installers and field leaders
    • Career advancement within HVAC and the broader home services industry

    A Real Career Path

    This isn’t just a helper position.

    The goal is to develop you into a skilled HVAC professional.

    As you build your technical knowledge and demonstrate strong performance, you’ll have opportunities to take on more responsibility, work more independently, and progress toward becoming an HVAC Installer and eventually a Lead Installer.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means showing up ready to learn, working safely, supporting your installation team, and improving your skills every day.

    You won’t be expected to know everything when you start. You will be expected to ask questions, take coaching seriously, work hard, and take pride in learning the trade.

    If you’re ready to build a career where your skills can grow along with your earning potential, Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric wants to hear from you.

    HVAC Install Helper

    New Berlin Heating & Air Conditioning | New Berlin, WI

    About New Berlin Heating & Air Conditioning

    New Berlin Heating & Air Conditioning helps homeowners stay comfortable through Wisconsin’s changing seasons. Our team installs and services a variety of heating and cooling systems, including furnaces, air conditioners, boilers, and indoor air quality equipment. We take pride in our work, support one another, and believe in helping people develop the skills to build successful careers in the trades.

    Interested in learning a hands-on trade and building skills that can last a lifetime?

    We’re looking for a motivated and dependable HVAC Install Helper to join our team! This is a great opportunity for someone just starting out, whether you’ve recently graduated from high school or are looking for a career path that goes beyond the classroom.

    No previous HVAC experience is required—we’re willing to teach the right person! You’ll work alongside experienced installers, learn how heating and cooling systems work, and gain valuable hands-on experience on residential job sites. If you enjoy working with your hands, learning new things, and being part of a team, this could be the perfect place to start your career.

    Benefits

    • Starting pay of $18 per hour

    • Hands-on training and mentorship from experienced HVAC professionals

    • Opportunity to build valuable trade skills

    • Career growth and advancement opportunities

    • Supportive, team-oriented work environment

    • Opportunity to develop a long-term career in the HVAC industry

    What You’ll Do

    • Help experienced installers set up and install heating and cooling equipment.

    • Assist with carrying, loading, and organizing tools, equipment, and materials.

    • Learn how to install ductwork and other HVAC components.

    • Help prepare job sites and keep work areas clean, organized, and safe.

    • Follow instructions and learn proper tool use and safety procedures.

    • Work alongside teammates to complete jobs efficiently and correctly.

    • Treat customers and coworkers with respect and professionalism.

    • Ask questions, accept feedback, and build your skills through hands-on experience.

    • Help maintain a clean and organized company vehicle.

    • Take on additional tasks as you learn and grow in the role.

    What We’re Looking For

    • A positive attitude and willingness to learn.

    • Dependability, punctuality, and a strong work ethic.

    • Interest in learning a skilled trade and developing a long-term career.

    • Ability to follow directions, ask questions, and work well with others.

    • Good communication skills and a respectful, professional attitude.

    • Attention to detail and a commitment to working safely.

    • Ability to perform physical work, including standing, bending, reaching, and lifting equipment or materials weighing up to 70 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

    • Reliable transportation to job sites and a valid driver’s license, if required for the position.

    No HVAC experience, EPA certification, or personal tools are required to get started. We’ll help you learn the basics and develop the skills you need to succeed!

    Join Our Team!

    You don’t need to have your whole career figured out to get started. At New Berlin Heating & Air Conditioning, you can learn from experienced professionals, develop practical skills, and explore a career with room to grow. If you’re ready to work hard, learn something new, and take the first step into the trades, we’d love to meet you. Apply today!

    HVAC Install Warranty Technician

    At Guy Smith Home Services, we’re looking for an HVAC Install Warranty Technician who takes pride in quality workmanship, accurate troubleshooting, and delivering an excellent customer experience. In this role, you’ll help ensure residential HVAC systems are operating properly after installation by diagnosing issues, resolving warranty-related concerns, and making necessary repairs.

    You’ll have the support of a knowledgeable office and operations team, the tools needed to work efficiently, and the opportunity to continue developing your technical skills. If you enjoy solving problems, take pride in your work, and want to make a difference for homeowners, we’d love to meet you!

    Benefits

    • Competitive Compensation: $30–$40/hour with weekly pay!

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

    • 401(k) with company match

    • Paid time off and paid holidays

    • Company-paid life and disability insurance

    • Paid training and professional development

    • Opportunities for career growth and advancement

    What You’ll Do

    • Respond to residential HVAC installation warranty calls and investigate customer concerns.

    • Troubleshoot heating and cooling systems to identify installation-related issues and determine the appropriate repairs.

    • Inspect HVAC equipment, components, and installation work to identify deficiencies and ensure proper operation.

    • Complete warranty repairs and adjustments in accordance with manufacturer specifications and company standards.

    • Test system performance after completing repairs to verify proper operation and performance.

    • Use diagnostic tools and technology to evaluate system operation and identify potential issues.

    • Clearly document findings, repairs, and recommendations in the company’s service system.

    • Communicate professionally with homeowners, explaining identified issues and completed repairs.

    • Coordinate with installation teams, service technicians, and the office team to resolve recurring concerns and improve customer satisfaction.

    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while following company procedures and safety standards.

    • Operate a company vehicle responsibly and maintain a professional appearance when representing Guy Smith Home Services.

    Gary & Sons – Falls Creek, PA

    HVAC Installer

    Build Your Career with a Company That Invests in You

    Since 1978, Gary & Sons has been a trusted name in home comfort throughout DuBois, Falls Creek, and the surrounding communities. For more than four decades, we've built our reputation on quality workmanship, integrity, and exceptional customer service.

    As a family-oriented company, we believe our employees are the foundation of our success. We invest in ongoing training, provide opportunities for career advancement, and foster a supportive culture where every team member is valued. If you're looking for more than just another HVAC job, we'd love to have you join our team.

    Why Join Gary & Sons?

    • Competitive pay based on experience and performance

    • Full-time, year-round employment

    • Overtime opportunities during peak seasons

    • Medical Insurance

    • Paid Vacation and Holidays

    • Retirement Plan

    • Company-provided uniforms

    • Ongoing technical training and career development

    • Supportive, family-oriented culture

    • Opportunity to grow with an established company

    The Role

    As an HVAC Installer, you'll install residential heating and cooling systems while delivering the high-quality workmanship and customer service Gary & Sons is known for. You'll work alongside experienced professionals to complete installations safely, efficiently, and according to manufacturer specifications and local code requirements.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Install residential heating, air conditioning, heat pump, ductless, and indoor air quality systems.

    • Replace and install furnaces, air conditioners, boilers, heat pumps, and related HVAC equipment.

    • Perform equipment startups, system testing, and final commissioning.

    • Install refrigerant lines, condensate drains, gas piping, electrical connections, and ductwork as required.

    • Read and interpret installation manuals, wiring diagrams, and blueprints.

    • Ensure all installations comply with local codes, manufacturer specifications, and company quality standards.

    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe job site while protecting customers' homes.

    • Communicate professionally with homeowners, explaining completed work and answering questions.

    • Work closely with team members to complete projects on schedule.

    • Accurately complete installation documentation and required paperwork.

    Qualifications

    • Previous residential HVAC installation experience preferred.

    • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.

    • Knowledge of heating, cooling, refrigeration, electrical, and airflow principles.

    • Experience installing furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, boilers, or ductless systems.

    • EPA Universal Certification preferred.

    • Ability to lift equipment and work in attics, crawlspaces, and confined areas.

    • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

    HVAC Installer

    Build Your Career with a Company That Invests in You

    Since 1978, Gary & Sons has been a trusted name in home comfort throughout DuBois, Falls Creek, and the surrounding communities. For more than four decades, we've built our reputation on quality workmanship, integrity, and exceptional customer service.

    As a family-oriented company, we believe our employees are the foundation of our success.     Why Join Gary & Sons?

    • Competitive pay based on experience and performance

    • Full-time, year-round employment

    • Overtime opportunities during peak seasons

    • Medical Insurance

    • Paid Vacation and Holidays

    • Retirement Plan

    • Company-provided uniforms

    • Ongoing technical training and career development

    • Supportive, family-oriented culture

    • Opportunity to grow with an established company

    The Role

    As an HVAC Installer, you'll install residential heating and cooling systems while delivering the high-quality workmanship and customer service Gary & Sons is known for.     Key Responsibilities

    • Install residential heating, air conditioning, heat pump, ductless, and indoor air quality systems.

    • Install refrigerant lines, condensate drains, gas piping, electrical connections, and ductwork as required.

    • Read and interpret installation manuals, wiring diagrams, and blueprints.

    • Ensure all installations comply with local codes, manufacturer specifications, and company quality standards.

    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe job site while protecting customers' homes.

    • Communicate professionally with homeowners, explaining completed work and answering questions.

    • Work closely with team members to complete projects on schedule.

    • Accurately complete installation documentation and required paperwork.

    • Previous residential HVAC installation experience preferred.

    • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.

    • Knowledge of heating, cooling, refrigeration, electrical, and airflow principles.

    • Experience installing furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, boilers, or ductless systems.

    • EPA Universal Certification preferred.

    • Ability to lift equipment and work in attics, crawlspaces, and confined areas.

    • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Positive attitude, strong work ethic, and commitment to quality workmanship.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means delivering quality installations the first time, working safely and efficiently, providing an exceptional customer experience, and helping Gary & Sons continue its reputation as one of Central Pennsylvania's most trusted home service companies.

    HVAC Installer

    Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical | Norwalk, CT

    Build Your HVAC Career with a Team That Takes Pride in Doing It Right

    At Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical, we help homeowners stay safe and comfortable through dependable heating, cooling, plumbing, and electrical services.

    We’re looking for an experienced HVAC Installer who takes pride in clean workmanship, professional service, and completing installations correctly the first time. You’ll install residential heating and cooling systems, work alongside a supportive team, and have the tools and resources needed to deliver high-quality results.

    If you’re dependable, mechanically skilled, and ready to grow with a company that values your expertise, we want to talk to you.

    What You’ll Do

    • Install residential furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-split systems, thermostats, and indoor air quality equipment.

    • Remove existing equipment and prepare jobsites for new installations.

    • Complete ductwork modifications, refrigerant piping, condensate drainage, venting, gas piping, wiring, and related system connections.

    • Review job documentation, equipment specifications, and installation requirements before beginning work.

    • Perform equipment startups, system testing, charging, airflow verification, and commissioning.

    • Troubleshoot installation-related issues and make necessary adjustments.

    • Ensure all work complies with manufacturer requirements, applicable codes, permit requirements, and company standards.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, organized, and safe jobsite.

    • Explain system operation, maintenance expectations, and warranty information to homeowners.

    • Complete accurate equipment records, job notes, photos, and required documentation.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, equipment, materials, and inventory.

    • Communicate professionally with customers, office staff, and coworkers.

    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and safety programs.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential HVAC installation experience.

    • Strong knowledge of furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-splits, ductwork, refrigeration, airflow, venting, and related system components.

    • Ability to complete residential HVAC installations safely and efficiently.

    • Strong mechanical, troubleshooting, and jobsite problem-solving skills.

    • Commitment to quality workmanship, safety, and code compliance.

    • Professional communication and customer service skills.

    • Ability to read equipment specifications, wiring diagrams, and installation instructions.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • EPA certification required.

    • Active Connecticut S-1, S-2, D-1, D-2, B-1, or B-2 license preferred.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to lift equipment and work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.

    Compensation and Benefits

    • Competitive compensation based on experience

    • Performance-based earning opportunities

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Vehicle

    • Company Phone or Tablet

    • Uniforms Provided

    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Safety Training

    • Year-Round Work

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means completing clean, dependable installations, ensuring systems operate correctly before leaving the jobsite, and treating every customer’s home with care. You’ll contribute to a strong installation team and help Astacio maintain its reputation for quality, professionalism, and reliable service.

    HVAC Installer

    Allied Experts | Cherry Hill, NJ

    Step Into a Rewarding HVAC Career with Allied Experts

    Are you looking for a long-term career with a company that values quality workmanship, professionalism, and continued growth? Do you take pride in doing the job right and leaving every customer’s home better than you found it? If so, there may be a place for you on the Allied Experts installation team.

    At Allied Experts, we’ve built a strong reputation for providing dependable HVAC and plumbing services throughout Cherry Hill and South Jersey. Our team helps homeowners create healthier, safer, more comfortable, and more energy-efficient homes through quality products, modern technology, and exceptional service.

    As an HVAC Installer, you’ll work alongside skilled professionals to install residential heating and cooling systems safely, efficiently, and according to our high standards. You’ll have the support, training, tools, and resources needed to strengthen your skills and build a lasting career in the HVAC industry.

    If you have a positive attitude, a strong work ethic, and a commitment to quality, we’d love to meet you.

    Apply today and take the next step in your HVAC career with Allied Experts.

    What You’ll Do

    • Install residential furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-split systems, thermostats, and indoor air quality equipment.
    • Remove and properly dispose of existing HVAC equipment.
    • Complete ductwork modifications, refrigerant piping, condensate drainage, venting, gas piping, wiring, and related system connections.
    • Assist with equipment startup, testing, charging, airflow verification, and commissioning.
    • Review job documentation, equipment specifications, and installation requirements before beginning work.
    • Identify and communicate equipment, material, or jobsite concerns promptly.
    • Follow manufacturer instructions, applicable codes, safety requirements, and company installation standards.
    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, organized, and professional jobsite.
    • Explain basic equipment operation and maintenance information to homeowners.
    • Complete required job documentation, equipment records, and photos using company software.
    • Maintain assigned tools, equipment, materials, and vehicle inventory.
    • Participate in ongoing technical, product, safety, and customer service training.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential HVAC installation experience preferred.
    • Knowledge of furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-splits, ductwork, refrigeration, venting, and related components.
    • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
    • Commitment to quality workmanship, safety, and code compliance.
    • Professional appearance and respect for customers and their homes.
    • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
    • Dependable attendance, punctuality, and work ethic.
    • Ability to follow instructions and complete assignments efficiently.
    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.
    • EPA certification preferred.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
    • Ability to lift equipment and materials and work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.

    What We Offer

    In exchange for your skills and commitment, Allied Experts offers:

    • Company vehicle, gas card, cell phone, and tablet upon completion of training
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • High-quality, affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • Health Savings Account with company contributions
    • Company-Paid Short-Term Disability Insurance
    • Company-Paid Long-Term Disability Insurance
    • Company-Paid Life Insurance
    • Paid Holidays
    • Paid Time Off
    • Parental Leave
    • Tuition Reimbursement
    • Tool Account
    • Safety Shoe Reimbursement
    • Employee discounts on a variety of services and entertainment
    • Family and friends discounts on company services
    • Annual Performance Reviews
    • Ongoing Training and Career Development
    • Year-Round Work
    • Opportunities for Advancement

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means completing clean, dependable, and professional HVAC installations while treating every customer’s home with care. You’ll work safely, support your installation team, continue building your technical skills, and help Allied Experts deliver the quality and comfort homeowners throughout South Jersey expect.

    Lead HVAC Installer

    John Nugent & Sons | Sterling, VA

    Experienced HVAC installers know that completing great work takes more than technical ability. It takes accurate job information, dependable materials, strong coordination, and a company that gives its installation teams the support needed to do the job right.

    John Nugent & Sons has served homeowners throughout Northern Virginia since 1975, building its reputation on quality workmanship, dependable service, and professionals who take pride in their craft.

    We’re looking for an experienced Lead HVAC Installer who can take ownership of residential installation projects, solve challenges in the field, and set the standard for quality and professionalism. You’ll lead projects from start to finish, guide apprentices and helpers, and work closely with our sales, warehouse, service, and operations teams to keep installations moving efficiently.

    This is an opportunity to join an established home services company where your experience will be respected, your leadership will make an impact, and you’ll have the resources needed to deliver installations you’re proud to put your name on.

    What You’ll Do

    • Lead residential HVAC replacement and installation projects from start to finish.

    • Install furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-splits, thermostats, and indoor air quality equipment.

    • Complete ductwork modifications, refrigerant piping, condensate drainage, venting, gas piping, wiring, and related system connections.

    • Direct, train, and support apprentices and installation helpers.

    • Review job details and identify equipment, material, or scope concerns before and during installation.

    • Perform equipment startups, charging, airflow verification, system testing, and commissioning.

    • Troubleshoot installation issues and ensure work meets manufacturer requirements, applicable codes, and company standards.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain clean, organized, and safe jobsites.

    • Explain system operation, maintenance expectations, and warranty information to homeowners.

    • Complete accurate job documentation, equipment records, and required photos.

    • Coordinate with sales, service, dispatch, warehouse, and operations teams.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, equipment, materials, and inventory.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous experience leading residential HVAC replacement and installation projects.

    • Ability to independently complete residential HVAC installations from start to finish.

    • Strong knowledge of furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-splits, ductwork, refrigeration, airflow, venting, and system commissioning.

    • Strong troubleshooting, leadership, and jobsite problem-solving skills.

    • Ability to train, coach, and direct apprentices or installation helpers.

    • Commitment to quality workmanship, safety, and code compliance.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • EPA Universal Certification required.

    • Applicable Virginia trade licenses or certifications preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Work at John Nugent & Sons?

    • Competitive compensation based on experience

    • Performance-based earning opportunities

    • Steady, year-round installation demand

    • Strong office, warehouse, and operational support

    • Established Northern Virginia reputation dating back to 1975

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Vehicle

    • Company Phone or Tablet

    • Uniforms Provided

    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Leadership Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • The opportunity to train and develop future HVAC professionals

    • Support from an experienced HVAC, plumbing, and electrical team

    • A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means taking ownership of each installation, leading your crew effectively, and delivering clean, dependable work that performs as intended. You’ll ensure every system is properly tested before completion, help develop less-experienced installers, and contribute to the quality experience that has kept Northern Virginia homeowners choosing John Nugent & Sons for generations.

    Lead HVAC Installer

    Location: Concord, NH
    Pay: $35.00–$45.00 per hour

    Join the Live Free Team!

    At Live Free Heating, Cooling, Electric & Plumbing, we're committed to delivering exceptional service and quality workmanship to homeowners throughout New Hampshire. We're growing and looking for an experienced Lead HVAC Installer who takes pride in their craft, enjoys leading by example, and wants to build a long-term career with a company that values its people.

    If you're an experienced installer who thrives in residential HVAC, enjoys mentoring others, and wants to work with a company that invests in its team, we'd love to hear from you.

    What You'll Do

    • Lead residential HVAC installations from start to finish.
    • Install furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, air handlers, and related equipment.
    • Perform brazing, venting, gas piping, refrigerant piping, and system commissioning.
    • Read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, and manufacturer specifications.
    • Troubleshoot installation challenges and make field adjustments as needed.
    • Ensure every installation meets manufacturer specifications and local code requirements.
    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe jobsite and company vehicle.
    • Communicate professionally with homeowners and provide an outstanding customer experience.
    • Mentor and train apprentices and installation helpers.
    • Complete all required paperwork accurately using ServiceTitan and other company systems.

    What We're Looking For

    • 5+ years of residential HVAC installation experience.
    • Strong experience installing furnaces, boilers, heat pumps, mini-splits, and central air systems.
    • Experience with brazing, venting, gas piping, system commissioning, and startup.
    • Ability to troubleshoot installation issues independently.
    • Comfortable reading blueprints, wiring diagrams, and installation manuals.
    • Leadership experience directing apprentices or install helpers.
    • Strong communication and customer service skills.
    • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
    • Able to adapt to changing field conditions while maintaining quality workmanship.
    • Experience working in New England weather conditions is preferred.
    • Experience with ServiceTitan is a plus.

    Required Licenses & Certifications

    • Valid New Hampshire Gas License (Required)
    • EPA 608 Universal Certification (Required)
    • Valid Driver's License with a clean driving record (Required)

    Preferred Certifications

    • Heat Pump Training
    • Mitsubishi, Lennox, or other manufacturer installation certifications
    • Additional HVAC industry certifications

    Why Live Free?

    • Competitive pay: $35.00–$45.00 per hour
    • Year-round, full-time work
    • Growth and advancement opportunities
    • Supportive team environment
    • Company that values craftsmanship, professionalism, and customer satisfaction

    If you're an experienced HVAC installer looking for a company where your skills are valued and your career can continue to grow, we'd love to hear from you!

    HVAC Sales | A to Z Dependable

    At A to Z, we're passionate about delivering top-notch home services that our customers can rely on. Our team takes pride in providing expert solutions, exceptional customer service, and making a real difference in the lives of homeowners.

    We're looking for a motivated, results-driven HVAC Sales Professional who knows how to build relationships, understand customer needs, and close sales. In this role, you'll meet with homeowners to evaluate their heating and cooling needs, present customized comfort solutions, and help customers make confident decisions about their home comfort investments.

    The ideal candidate has a proven track record in sales, thrives in a performance-driven environment, and takes pride in delivering an exceptional customer experience. Whether you're an experienced HVAC sales professional or a successful in-home sales professional looking for a new opportunity, we'd love to hear from you!

    Compensation & Benefits

    • Competitive, performance-based compensation with uncapped earning potential

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

    • 401(k) with company match

    • Paid time off and paid holidays

    • Company-paid life and disability insurance

    • Paid training and professional development

    • Opportunities for career growth and advancement

     

    What You'll Do

    • Conduct in-home consultations to evaluate homeowners' heating, cooling, and indoor air quality needs

    • Build trust with customers through a consultative, solutions-focused sales approach

    • Present customized HVAC replacement and upgrade options based on customer needs and budgets

    • Clearly explain equipment options, benefits, warranties, and available financing solutions

    • Prepare and present proposals, confidently ask for the sale, and follow through to close opportunities

    • Consistently meet or exceed individual sales goals and performance expectations

    • Follow up with prospective customers to answer questions and convert opportunities into sales

    • Utilize CRM systems to manage leads, track sales activity, and maintain accurate customer records

    • Collaborate with technicians, installation teams, and office staff to ensure a smooth customer experience

    • Identify opportunities to recommend additional comfort solutions, indoor air quality products, and maintenance memberships

    • Stay current on HVAC products, industry trends, and sales best practices
     

    What We're Looking For

    Required Qualifications

    • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals

    • Strong consultative selling and relationship-building skills

    • Ability to present solutions and confidently ask for the sale

    • Experience conducting in-home customer appointments

    • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record

    • Excellent communication, presentation, and customer service skills

    • Basic proficiency with CRM systems and mobile technology

    • Ability to work evenings and Saturdays as needed

    • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working in a performance-driven environment

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Previous HVAC sales or Comfort Advisor experience

    • Knowledge of residential heating, cooling, and indoor air quality systems

    • Experience presenting financing options and monthly payment solutions

    • Experience with both lead-generated and self-generated sales opportunities

    • Familiarity with ServiceTitan or similar field service management software

    • Experience selling maintenance memberships or service agreements

    • Background in in-home sales, including roofing, windows, solar, remodeling, or other home improvement industries

    • Residential HVAC technicians with strong customer communication and sales abilities

     

    What Success Looks Like

    • Consistently meets or exceeds sales goals and performance expectations

    • Builds strong customer relationships through trust, professionalism, and consultative selling

    • Confidently presents solutions and helps homeowners make informed purchasing decisions

    • Maintains strong closing rates and follows up on sales opportunities

    • Works collaboratively with technicians and installation teams to ensure customer satisfaction

    • Takes ownership of results and continuously looks for opportunities to improve

    • Delivers an exceptional customer experience from the initial consultation through the completed sale

     

    Join Our Team!

    If you're a driven sales professional who enjoys helping homeowners, building relationships, and being rewarded for your performance, we'd love to hear from you! Join A to Z and build a rewarding career helping customers find the right home comfort solutions.

    Sales Manager

    At AA Service Co, we recognize and appreciate the craftsmanship and passion that our team bring to their work.     • Monitor KPIs, sales metrics, and close rates to ensure team success
    • Uphold a customer-first approach that ensures homeowners receive tailored solutions and an outstanding experience

    This is a leadership position for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, performance-based environment and knows how to build a culture of accountability, motivation, and high achievement.

    If you’re looking for stability, advancement opportunities, and a compensation plan that rewards strong leadership and sales performance, we invite you to join Jones Services and experience what it’s like to work for a company that works just as hard for you.

    Sales Manager Duties and Responsibilities

    • Overseeing sales, promotions, and campaigns
    • Ability to design and implement successful sales strategies and motivate, influence, and impact a team of Sales Reps.
    • Planning and directing the hiring and training of new Sales Representatives
    • Directing and coordinating all sales activities.
    • Preparing sales budgets and projections and approving expenditures
    • Tracking and analyzing sales statistics based on key quantitative metrics
    • Handling and resolving customer complaints regarding a product or service
    • Setting discount rates and determining price schedules
    • Advising distributors and dealers on policies and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

    Sales Manager Skills and Qualifications

    • Ability to set sales targets and achieve them effectively
    • Excellent interpersonal, customer service and communication skills
    • Experience using CRM to manage the sales process and forecast sales
    • Strong analytical skills to identify trends and sales patterns
    • Ability to guide and mentor sales representatives
    • Planning, organization, and problem-solving skills
    • You can be successful in this position if you:
    • Are self-motivated
    • Possess excellent one-on-one presentation skills
    • Assertive and results-oriented with a need to succeed
    • Highly organized with exceptional follow-through abilities
    • Outgoing personality that blends well with a fast-paced, goal-driven environment
    • Highly motivated, flexible and great attitude on life
    • Hold customer service as a top priority
    • Conduct business based on honesty and integrity

    Compensation: Base Salary (based on experience, geography, and span of control) + commission and bonus plan

    Total Pay: (Base + Commission) - $120,000 - $280,000 per year

    HVAC Service Apprentice | Sila Boston

    At Sila Boston, we take care of our people, invest in great tools and training, and provide real opportunities to grow. You'll have a strong team behind you and the resources of a growing company, without losing that local team feel.

    We're looking for a motivated, dependable HVAC Service Apprentice who is eager to learn and grow in the HVAC industry. In this role, you'll work alongside experienced service technicians, gaining hands-on experience diagnosing, maintaining, and repairing residential heating and cooling systems.

    The ideal candidate has great communication skills, a positive attitude, and a willingness to learn. Whether you've completed HVAC school, have some prior training, or are just getting started, we're looking for someone who takes pride in their work and wants to build a long-term career in the trades.

    Compensation & Benefits

    • Competitive compensation: $20 - $25/hour with weekly pay!

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

    • 401(k) with company match

    • Paid time off and paid holidays

    • Company-paid life and disability insurance

    • Paid training and professional development

    • Opportunities for career growth and advancement

     

    What You'll Do

    • Assist experienced HVAC Service Technicians with diagnosing, maintaining, and repairing residential heating and cooling systems

    • Learn to troubleshoot HVAC equipment, including furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, and heat pumps

    • Perform basic maintenance tasks under the guidance of experienced technicians

    • Assist with inspections, cleaning, and testing HVAC equipment

    • Learn proper use of HVAC tools, equipment, and diagnostic instruments

    • Communicate professionally with homeowners and team members

    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment

    • Follow company safety procedures and industry best practices

    • Support technicians with documenting service work and completing job-related tasks

    • Participate in ongoing training and development to build technical skills and industry knowledge
     

    What We're Looking For

    Required Qualifications

    • Great communication skills

    • Valid driver's license

    A Comfort Service
    Pittsburgh, PA

    Pay: $28-38/hr + Incentives + Potential Sign On Bonus

    Join Pittsburgh's Trusted Home Comfort Team

    At A Comfort Service, we've built our reputation by providing homeowners throughout the Pittsburgh area with honest service, quality workmanship, and exceptional customer care. We take pride in doing the job right the first time and creating an environment where our employees can build long-term, successful careers.

    As we continue to grow, we are looking for an experienced HVAC Service Technician to join our team.

    Position Summary

    The HVAC Service Technician is responsible for diagnosing, repairing, servicing, and maintaining residential heating and cooling systems while delivering an outstanding customer experience. The ideal candidate is technically strong, customer-focused, and takes pride in helping homeowners solve their comfort issues.

    Responsibilities

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair residential HVAC systems
    • Perform preventative maintenance and seasonal tune-ups
    • Service furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, boilers, mini-split systems, and indoor air quality equipment
    • Educate homeowners on repair and replacement options
    • Present solutions that best meet customer needs
    • Complete service calls efficiently while maintaining high-quality workmanship
    • Maintain accurate service records and job documentation

    HVAC Service Technician

    Gary & Sons | Falls Creek, PA

    Experienced HVAC technicians have choices. The right opportunity should offer more than a full schedule—it should provide reliable support, quality equipment, continued training, and a team that respects the expertise you bring to every service call.

    At Gary & Sons, we’ve been serving homeowners throughout the region since 1978. Our reputation has been built by skilled professionals who take pride in dependable workmanship, honest communication, and treating customers the right way.

    As an HVAC Service Technician, you’ll have steady, year-round customer demand and the support of an established, team-oriented company behind you. You’ll diagnose and repair residential heating and cooling systems, help homeowners understand their options, and have the resources needed to deliver quality service without cutting corners.

    If you’re looking for a stable company where your technical ability is valued, your performance is recognized, and you can continue building your career, Gary & Sons may be the right place for your next move.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, service, repair, and maintain residential heating and cooling systems.

    • Work on furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, air handlers, and indoor air quality equipment.

    • Troubleshoot electrical, refrigeration, airflow, mechanical, hydronic, and combustion-related issues.

    • Perform preventive maintenance, equipment startups, system testing, and safety inspections.

    • Explain diagnosed problems and recommend appropriate repair, maintenance, or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Maintain accurate service notes, equipment records, photos, and follow-up information.

    • Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, diagnostic equipment, and truck inventory.

    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential HVAC service, repair, and maintenance experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Experience servicing furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, and related systems.

    • Knowledge of refrigeration, electrical, airflow, combustion, hydronic, and control systems.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available solutions clearly to homeowners.

    • Commitment to safe, dependable, and high-quality work.

    • EPA Universal Certification required.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Work at Gary & Sons?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support

    • Established local reputation dating back to 1978

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • Retirement plan with company contribution

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Vehicle

    • Company Phone or Tablet

    • Uniforms and Professional Diagnostic Equipment

    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Customer Service Training

    • Opportunities for Overtime

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Supportive, family-oriented work environment

    • A company that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing HVAC problems accurately, completing dependable repairs, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll communicate professionally, document your work thoroughly, and help Gary & Sons continue earning customer trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.
