    HVAC Service Technician

    Gary & Sons | Falls Creek, PA

    Experienced HVAC technicians have choices. The right opportunity should offer more than a full schedule—it should provide reliable support, quality equipment, continued training, and a team that respects the expertise you bring to every service call.

    At Gary & Sons, we’ve been serving homeowners throughout the region since 1978. Our reputation has been built by skilled professionals who take pride in dependable workmanship, honest communication, and treating customers the right way.

    As an HVAC Service Technician, you’ll have steady, year-round customer demand and the support of an established, team-oriented company behind you. You’ll diagnose and repair residential heating and cooling systems, help homeowners understand their options, and have the resources needed to deliver quality service without cutting corners.

    If you’re looking for a stable company where your technical ability is valued, your performance is recognized, and you can continue building your career, Gary & Sons may be the right place for your next move.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, service, repair, and maintain residential heating and cooling systems.

    • Work on furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, air handlers, and indoor air quality equipment.

    • Troubleshoot electrical, refrigeration, airflow, mechanical, hydronic, and combustion-related issues.

    • Perform preventive maintenance, equipment startups, system testing, and safety inspections.

    • Explain diagnosed problems and recommend appropriate repair, maintenance, or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Maintain accurate service notes, equipment records, photos, and follow-up information.

    • Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, diagnostic equipment, and truck inventory.

    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential HVAC service, repair, and maintenance experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Experience servicing furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, and related systems.

    • Knowledge of refrigeration, electrical, airflow, combustion, hydronic, and control systems.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available solutions clearly to homeowners.

    • Commitment to safe, dependable, and high-quality work.

    • EPA Universal Certification required.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Work at Gary & Sons?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support

    • Established local reputation dating back to 1978

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • Retirement plan with company contribution

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Vehicle

    • Company Phone or Tablet

    • Uniforms and Professional Diagnostic Equipment

    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Customer Service Training

    • Opportunities for Overtime

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Supportive, family-oriented work environment

    • A company that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing HVAC problems accurately, completing dependable repairs, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll communicate professionally, document your work thoroughly, and help Gary & Sons continue earning customer trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.

    At John Nugent & Sons, we’ve built a long-standing reputation throughout Northern Virginia by delivering dependable home services and treating customers the right way. That reputation starts with skilled technicians who take pride in accurate diagnostics, quality repairs, and professional communication.

    As an HVAC Service Technician, you’ll have the support of an experienced dispatch, customer service, and operations team behind you. You’ll diagnose and repair residential heating and cooling systems, help homeowners understand their options, and have the resources needed to deliver quality service without cutting corners.

    If you’re looking for year-round work, strong operational support, and a company where your technical ability and customer care are genuinely valued, John Nugent & Sons may be the right place for your next move.

    Why Work at John Nugent & Sons?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities (Weekly Pay!)

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • High Quality and Affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Vehicle and tablet

    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Customer Service Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, service, repair, and maintain residential heating and cooling systems.

    • Work on furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, air handlers, thermostats, and indoor air quality equipment.

    • Troubleshoot electrical, refrigeration, airflow, mechanical, hydronic, and combustion-related issues.

    • Perform preventive maintenance, equipment startups, system testing, and safety inspections.

    • Explain diagnosed problems and recommend appropriate repair, maintenance, or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate service notes, equipment records, photos, and follow-up documentation.

    • Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, diagnostic equipment, and truck inventory.

    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, installation, and management teams.

    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential HVAC service, repair, and maintenance experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Experience servicing furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, and related systems.

    • Knowledge of refrigeration, electrical, airflow, combustion, hydronic, and control systems.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.

    • Commitment to safe, dependable, and high-quality work.

    • EPA Universal Certification required.

    • Applicable Virginia trade licenses or certifications preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing HVAC problems accurately, completing dependable repairs, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll communicate professionally, document your work thoroughly, and help John Nugent & Sons continue earning customer trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.

    HVAC Service Technician

    Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric | Lynchburg, VA

    Build Your Career with a Company That Invests in Its Technicians

    Experienced HVAC technicians have options. The right company should give you more than a full schedule—it should give you steady customer demand, strong support, quality equipment, continued training, and the opportunity to grow.

    At Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric, we’re looking for experienced HVAC Service Technicians who take pride in accurate diagnostics, quality workmanship, and creating a professional customer experience.

    Davis has served homeowners since 1947 and has built a reputation around craftsmanship, integrity, strong community roots, and taking care of both customers and employees.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential heating and cooling systems.
    • Perform preventative maintenance and system inspections.
    • Identify mechanical, electrical, airflow, and performance issues.
    • Explain findings and available repair or replacement options clearly to homeowners.
    • Complete repairs safely, efficiently, and according to manufacturer specifications.
    • Identify opportunities for system upgrades, indoor air quality improvements, and equipment replacement when appropriate.
    • Complete accurate service notes, estimates, photos, and required documentation.
    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.
    • Maintain assigned tools, equipment, vehicle, and truck inventory.
    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, installation, and other field teams.
    • Participate in ongoing technical, safety, and customer-service training.

    What We’re Looking For

    • 2+ years of residential HVAC service experience preferred.
    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills.
    • EPA certification required.
    • Strong customer service and communication skills.
    • Ability to work independently and manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.
    • Commitment to safe, high-quality workmanship.
    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    Why Work at Davis?

    • Competitive compensation and advancement opportunities
    • Steady, year-round customer demand
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • Retirement Plan with Company Match
    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
    • Company Vehicle for qualified field roles
    • Tool Account Program
    • Uniforms and major equipment provided
    • Ongoing technical training and professional development
    • Leadership development opportunities
    • Supportive, team-oriented work environment
    • Stable company with deep community roots

    What Success Looks Like

    Success means diagnosing problems accurately, completing dependable repairs, communicating clearly with homeowners, and helping customers feel confident in the recommendations you provide.

    You’ll deliver strong technical work while representing Davis with professionalism, accountability, and respect.

    HVAC Service Technician

    Location: Rochester/Geneva, NY
    Company: T-Mark Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric

    Looking for Your Next Great HVAC Career?

    Join a team that values your experience, invests in your growth, and keeps you busy year-round. If you know residential HVAC and enjoy taking care of customers, T-Mark is the place for you.

    We're looking for an experienced HVAC Service Technician who enjoys troubleshooting, solving problems, and delivering exceptional service to homeowners throughout Western New York. If you're dependable, motivated, and ready to grow with a company that values its people, we'd love to meet you.

    Pay: $25-32/hr + Incentives 

    What You'll Do

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential HVAC systems
    • Perform preventative maintenance on heating and cooling equipment
    • Service and maintain:
      • Furnaces
      • Air Conditioners
      • Heat Pumps
      • Boilers
      • Oil Heating Systems
      • Ductless Mini-Split Systems
      • Rooftop Units (RTUs)
    • Identify system issues and recommend repair or replacement solutions
    • Educate homeowners on equipment performance, maintenance plans, and energy-saving opportunities
    • Deliver an outstanding customer experience on every service call
    • Complete service documentation accurately
    • Communicate professionally with customers, dispatchers, and teammates
    • Maintain your company vehicle, tools, and equipment
    • Participate in ongoing technical training
    • Participate in a rotating weekend on-call schedule

    What We're Looking For

    Required Qualifications

    • Minimum 2 years of residential HVAC service experience
    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
    • Experience servicing furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, boilers, oil heating systems, mini-splits, and RTUs
    • EPA Certification required
    • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
    • Must have your own basic HVAC hand tools
    • Excellent customer service and communication skills
    • Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment
    • Weekend on-call availability on a rotating schedule

    Preferred Qualifications

    • EPA Universal Certification
    • NATE Certification
    • Experience using ServiceTitan
    • Experience with indoor air quality products and humidification systems
    • Experience recommending repairs, accessories, or replacement options to homeowners

    What Makes You Successful

    • Strong mechanical aptitude
    • Excellent problem-solving skills
    • Positive attitude and professional appearance
    • Dependable, motivated, and safety-focused
    • Pride in quality workmanship
    • Ability to build trust and lasting relationships with customers
    • Strong time management and organizational skills

    Why You'll Love Working at T-Mark

    • Competitive Pay
    • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Paid Time Off
    • Paid Holidays
    • Company Vehicle
    • Company-Provided Uniforms
    • Year-Round Work
    • Paid Training and Continuing Education
    • Career Advancement Opportunities
    • Supportive Leadership Team
    • A Company That Invests in Your Success

    Why T-Mark?

    At T-Mark Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electric, we know our technicians are the heart of our business. That's why we provide the training, support, tools, and opportunities you need to build a long-term career. When you join T-Mark, you're joining a team that works hard, has each other's backs, and takes pride in delivering exceptional service every day.

    Ready to take the next step in your HVAC career? Apply today and become part of the T-Mark team!

    HVAC Service Technician

    My Plumber Plus | Manassas, VA

    The best HVAC Service Technicians do more than repair equipment. They solve problems, earn homeowners’ trust, and create the kind of experience customers remember.

    At My Plumber Plus, we believe skilled technicians should have the customer demand, operational support, and earning opportunity needed to perform at their best. You’ll have a knowledgeable dispatch and customer service team behind you, professional tools and technology, ongoing training, and a steady flow of service opportunities throughout the year.

    As an HVAC Service Technician, you’ll diagnose, repair, and maintain residential heating and cooling systems while helping homeowners understand their options and make informed decisions about their comfort. You’ll take ownership of each service call and be rewarded for delivering strong technical results and an exceptional customer experience.

    If you’re an experienced technician who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, communicates confidently with homeowners, and wants to work for a company that recognizes strong performance, we want to talk to you.

    What Can We Do for You?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities

    • Uncapped earning potential

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Take-home company vehicle with dispatch from home

    • Company gas card, phone, and tablet

    • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Vacation and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Uniforms

    • Tool Allowance

    • Professional Diagnostic Equipment

    • Ongoing Technical, Sales, and Customer Service Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Box Seats to Washington Capitals Games and Jiffy Lube Live

    • Team Events and Company Outings

    • Long-Term Stability

    • More than 30% of our employees have been with us for 10 years or longer

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, service, repair, and maintain residential heating and cooling systems.

    • Service furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-split systems, thermostats, and indoor air quality equipment.

    • Troubleshoot electrical, refrigeration, airflow, mechanical, and combustion-related issues.

    • Perform preventive maintenance, system testing, equipment startups, and safety inspections.

    • Clearly explain diagnosed problems and present appropriate repair, maintenance, or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer approval before performing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, equipment records, photos, and follow-up documentation.

    • Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, safe, and professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicle inventory, tools, equipment, and materials.

    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, installation, and management teams.

    • Participate in ongoing technical, safety, sales, and customer service training.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential HVAC service, repair, and maintenance experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Experience servicing air conditioners, furnaces, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-splits, and related systems.

    • Knowledge of refrigeration, electrical, airflow, mechanical, and combustion systems.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication, presentation, and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available solutions clearly to homeowners.

    • Comfortable recommending appropriate products and services based on customer needs.

    • Self-motivated, dependable, and driven to achieve performance goals.

    • Commitment to safe, dependable, and high-quality workmanship.

    • EPA Universal Certification required.

    • NATE Certification or applicable trade credentials preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing HVAC problems accurately, completing dependable repairs, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll take ownership of your service calls, deliver an exceptional customer experience, and benefit from a company that provides the demand, support, and resources needed to grow your earnings and career.

    Ready for What’s Next?

    If you’re looking for a company that values your expertise, supports your success, and gives strong performers the opportunity to maximize their potential, apply today.

    Job description:

    AA Service Co - HVAC Service Technician

    Are you passionate about delivering top-notch HVAC solutions?

    Do you feel like your current role doesn’t fully utilize your skills or offer the career growth you desire?

    Are you ready to join a team that truly values your expertise and supports your professional development?

    At AA Service Co, we recognize and appreciate the craftsmanship and passion that HVAC Service Technicians bring to their work. We are dedicated to fostering a supportive and rewarding environment where your skills are not only acknowledged but celebrated. Here, your contributions matter, and your growth is our priority. As a leader in the HVAC industry, we pride ourselves on delivering unmatched comfort and reliability to our customers, reflecting the high standards and dedication of our team. Our unwavering commitment to continuous training and development ensures that our team remains at the cutting edge of industry advancements. Join us, and let your passion for excellence shine in a company that values your craft and fuels your professional journey.

    To learn more about us, visit: http://www.aaserviceco.com

    We don't just offer jobs—we build careers. Here’s why you’ll love being part of our team:

    • Sign-on Bonus Up to $3,000! We value your skills and experience, and we’re ready to invest in you from day one.
    • Industry-Leading Compensation ($25 - $32/hr plus incentives!): We believe in rewarding excellence. Our Service Technician are amongst the best paid in the area via hourly wage and commissions!
    • Fully Stocked Warehouse & Parts Runners: We ensure you have the tools and support you need to excel, with a fully stocked warehouse and parts runners at your service.
    • New Clean Fully Stocked Truck: Drive in style with a new, clean, fully stocked TAKE-HOME truck that’s ready for any job.
    • Comprehensive Health Benefits: We offer affordable, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family covered.
    • Paid Time Off Starting Day 1! We believe in the importance of rest and relaxation, so you start earning paid time off from your first day.
    • 401(k) Plan with Company Match: Secure your future with our competitive 401(k) plan, including a generous company match.
    • Parental Leave: We support our team members through all stages of life, including offering parental leave for new parents.
    • Tool and Boot Allowance: We provide a tool and boot allowance to replace the things you use the most to get the job done.
    • Training and Development Opportunities: We’re committed to your professional growth with training at our new Service Professionals Academy & Resources Center!
    • Yearly Performance Reviews: We believe in continuous improvement and offer yearly performance reviews to ensure you’re on track and rewarded for your hard work.

    The best time to find a GREAT job is when you already have a GOOD job.

    Where you grow from here is up to you!

    In this role, you'll be responsible for:

    • Providing clear explanations and educate customers about their HVAC systems, offering preventive maintenance tips and energy-saving recommendations. Maintaining customer satisfaction rate through post-service surveys and feedback. Striving to exceed customer expectations and resolve any concerns promptly.
    • Effectively diagnosing and repairing malfunctioning a/c systems, gas and oil furnaces, gas and oil boilers, zoning systems, hydronic heating systems, as well as other HVAC equipment recommending appropriate solutions and discussing options with customers.
    • Achieving a best-in-class first-time fix rate by accurately diagnosing issues, arriving fully prepared with necessary tools and parts, and effectively completing repairs during the initial service call.
    • Demonstrating continuous improvement in technical skills and knowledge through training, certifications, and staying updated on industry best practices.
    • Responding to service requests within the defined time frame. Timely response ensures customer comfort and builds trust.
    • Completing annual maintenance of heating and air conditioning systems.
    • Participating as a member of our on-call rotation schedule for emergency service requests.
    • Identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional services, products, or maintenance plans to customers during service visits.
    • Remaining flexible and adaptable in work schedules and work assignments as defined by departmental and organizational needs.
    • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date records of service calls, work performed, and parts used in the Service Titan platform.
    • Maintaining a consistent record of punctuality and attendance, arriving at scheduled appointments on time and adhering to the assigned work schedule.
    • Additional Duties as Assigned

    Required Skills and Abilities:

    • Prior heating and/or cooling experience in a residential capacity.
    • Service Titan experience preferred
    • Experience upselling additional services as well as selling replacement options when applicable.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and communicate with customers.
    • Demonstrated excellent communication conflict resolution and interpersonal skills.
    • Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member and pitch in as needed.
    • Computer skills and use of electronic devices for scheduling, invoice creation and communication to staff and customers required.
    • Must be able to work on a ladder.
    • Must be able to lift 50 pounds.

    • Diagnose, service, repair, and maintain residential heating and cooling systems.

    • Work on furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, air handlers, and indoor air quality equipment.

    • Troubleshoot electrical, refrigeration, airflow, mechanical, hydronic, and combustion-related issues.

    • Perform preventive maintenance, system testing, safety inspections, and equipment startups.

    • Explain diagnosed problems and recommend appropriate repair, maintenance, or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Maintain accurate service notes, equipment records, photos, and follow-up information.

    • Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, diagnostic equipment, and truck inventory.

    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development.

    What We’re Looking For

    • 3 or more years of residential HVAC service, repair, and maintenance experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Experience servicing furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, and related systems.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available solutions clearly to homeowners.

    • EPA Universal Certification required.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software such as Service Titan.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing HVAC problems accurately, completing dependable repairs, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll maintain professional communication, document your work thoroughly, and help ECS Comfort continue earning customer trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.

    Install Apprentice - Havertown, PA

    Adam Home Services is built for professionals who take pride in their craft and want to work with a team that holds itself to a high standard. 

    We provide steady residential work, strong support from the office and field, and an environment where quality matters. If you want to be trusted to do your job, supported when you need it, and recognized for strong performance, this could be the right fit. 

    Benefits 

    • Competitive compensation: $25 - $30/hour with weekly pay!

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance 

    • 401(k) with company match 

    • Paid time off and paid holidays 

    • Company-paid life and disability insurance 

    • Paid training and professional development 

    • Opportunities for career growth and advancement 

    • Employee and family discounts on services 

     

    Essential Responsibilities 

    • Assist in installing HVAC related equipment according to manufacturer’s specifications. 

    • Help design, fabricate, and install various ducts and duct fittings as required. 

    • Help verify, receive, and load all equipment and materials needed for each job. 

    • Demonstrates and establishes effective working relationships with co-workers and superiors. 

    • Properly completes all the paperwork required for each job. 

    • Maintains cleanliness of assigned company vehicle. 

    • Maintains high levels of customer service and satisfaction. 

    • Performs all tasks and duties in an efficient and safe manner. 

    • Performs other related duties as assigned or as necessary. Remains flexible and adaptable in work schedules and work assignments as defined by departmental and organizational needs.

    $35–$55/Hour + Performance-Based Earning Opportunities
    Up to $5,000 Sign-On Bonus for Qualified Candidates!
    Weekly Pay | Company Vehicle & Gas Card | Full Benefits

    Join Sila Boston – Proud Partners of the Boston Bruins!

    We're proud to be an official partner of the Boston Bruins! Just like the Bruins, we believe in hard work, teamwork, and showing up ready to deliver our best every day.

    At Sila Boston, we know great plumbers are the backbone of our business. That's why we invest in our people, provide the tools and support they need to succeed, and offer opportunities to grow their careers and earning potential.

    We're looking for an experienced Licensed Journeyman Plumber who knows residential service, enjoys solving problems, and takes pride in doing the job right.

    If you're looking for steady work, competitive pay, and a company that values your skills and experience, we'd love to talk.

    What We Offer

    • $35–$55 per hour, paid weekly

    • Up to $5,000 sign-on bonus for qualified candidates

    • Performance-based earning opportunities

    • Company vehicle and gas card

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

    • 401(k) with company match

    • Paid time off and paid holidays

    • Ongoing technical training and professional development

    • Career advancement opportunities

    • Strong operational support and a team that has your back

    • The stability and resources of a growing company with the feel of a local team

    What You'll Be Doing

    As a Journeyman Plumber, you'll work directly with homeowners to diagnose problems, provide solutions, and deliver high-quality residential plumbing service.

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair residential plumbing systems.

    • Service, repair, and replace water heaters, including tankless and traditional units.

    • Repair and replace toilets, faucets, fixtures, water lines, drains, sump pumps, and other plumbing components.

    • Identify the root cause of plumbing issues and recommend effective, long-term solutions.

    • Explain findings and present repair or replacement options to homeowners.

    • Identify additional plumbing needs and recommend appropriate services.

    • Complete service calls efficiently while maintaining high standards for quality and customer satisfaction.

    • Follow Massachusetts plumbing codes and safety standards.

    • Document work and service details using ServiceTitan or similar software.

    • Maintain a clean, professional work environment and take pride in your workmanship.

    What We're Looking For

    • Active Massachusetts Journeyman Plumber license (PJ) – required.

    • 3+ years of residential plumbing service experience preferred.

    • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills with the ability to work independently.

    • Experience servicing and replacing water heaters, fixtures, piping, and drainage systems.

    • Knowledge of residential plumbing systems, materials, and Massachusetts plumbing codes.

    • Comfortable communicating directly with homeowners and explaining repair options.

    • Ability to provide estimates and recommend solutions based on customer needs.

    • Strong customer service skills and pride in delivering quality work.

    • Valid driver's license and ability to meet company driving requirements.

    Even Better If You Have:

    • Experience with ServiceTitan or similar field service software.

    • Experience with flat-rate pricing and presenting repair options.

    • Drain cleaning, sewer camera, or hydro jetting experience.

    • Experience mentoring apprentices or junior plumbers.

    • A strong track record of productivity, customer satisfaction, and minimizing callbacks.

    Ready to Make a Move?

    You worked hard to earn your plumbing license. You deserve to work for a company that recognizes your experience, supports your success, and gives you opportunities to earn more.

    At Sila Boston, you'll have steady work, a great team, and the tools and resources to do what you do best.

    Let's talk about your next opportunity. Apply today!

    Up to $5,000 Sign-On Bonus for Qualified Candidates!

    Journeyman Residential Electrician - Presque Isle, ME

    Dave’s World is more than just the largest residential heat pump company in Maine; we’re a family-oriented business rooted in integrity and excellence. With a commitment to delivering the highest quality HVAC installations, we pride ourselves on our values-based approach where the customer’s needs always come first. We foster a supportive environment, providing our team with the resources and opportunities they need to thrive and grow professionally.
     
    The Journeyman Electrician will perform residential electrical service work, support HVAC operations, ensure code compliance, and serve as the electrical subject matter expert for the organization. The ideal candidate has strong residential electrical experience, HVAC knowledge, leadership qualities, and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer service.
     

    What We Offer

    • Competitive compensation: $32+/hour with weekly pay!

    • Performance-based earning opportunities. 

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 

    • 401(k) with Company Match 

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays 

    • Company-Provided Vehicle 

    • Company Phone or Tablet 

    • Uniforms Provided 

    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Leadership Training 

    • Year-Round Work 

    • Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment 

     

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential electrical systems.

    • Install and replace panels, breakers, circuits, outlets, switches, lighting, ceiling fans, and other electrical components.

    • Complete service upgrades, wiring repairs, dedicated circuits, and electrical system improvements.

    • Install EV chargers, generators, surge protection, smoke detectors, and other residential electrical equipment.

    • Perform electrical safety inspections and identify code, safety, or performance concerns.

    • Clearly explain findings and present homeowners with appropriate repair or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer authorization before beginning work.

    • Identify opportunities to recommend additional products or services that improve safety, reliability, or convenience.

    • Prepare accurate estimates and complete service documentation using company software.

    • Ensure all work complies with the National Electrical Code, local requirements, and company standards.

    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area while protecting customers’ homes.

    • Maintain assigned vehicle inventory, tools, equipment, and materials.

    • Communicate professionally with customers, office staff, and coworkers.

    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development.

     

    What We’re Looking For

    • Active Maine Journeyman+ electrical license required.

    • Previous residential electrical service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills.

    • Knowledge of residential wiring methods, electrical systems, and applicable codes.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Comfortable presenting service options and making appropriate recommendations.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work.

    • Professional appearance and respect for customers and their homes.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.

     
     
    At Dave’s World, we understand the challenges Electricians face. That's why we're committed to creating a supportive and rewarding environment. Our dedication to craftsmanship and passion for excellence means your hard work will always be recognized and appreciated.
     
     
    Apply today!

    Burns & McBride Home Comfort | New Castle, DE

    Experienced HVAC installers know that great work requires more than technical skill. It takes the right materials, clear communication, strong coordination, and a company that gives its field teams the support needed to complete installations correctly.

    At Burns & McBride Home Comfort, we’re looking for an experienced Lead HVAC Installer who takes pride in craftsmanship, leads by example, and wants to work for a company that values quality over shortcuts. You’ll take ownership of residential installation projects, guide apprentices and helpers, and work closely with our sales, service, warehouse, and operations teams to keep jobs moving smoothly.

    What You’ll Do

    • Lead residential HVAC replacement and installation projects from start to finish.
    • Install furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-splits, thermostats, and indoor air quality equipment.
    • Complete ductwork modifications, refrigerant piping, condensate drainage, venting, gas piping, wiring, and system connections.

    • Perform equipment startups, charging, airflow verification, testing, and commissioning.
    • Troubleshoot installation issues and ensure work meets manufacturer requirements, applicable codes, and company standards.
    • Review job information and communicate equipment, material, or scope concerns promptly.
    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, safe, and professional jobsite.
    • Explain system operation, maintenance expectations, and warranty information to homeowners.
    • Complete accurate job documentation, equipment records, and required photos.
    • Coordinate with sales, service, dispatch, warehouse, and leadership teams.
    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, equipment, materials, and inventory.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous experience leading residential HVAC replacement and installation projects.
    • Ability to independently complete residential HVAC installations from start to finish.
    • Strong knowledge of heating and cooling equipment, ductwork, refrigeration, airflow, venting, and system commissioning.
    • Strong troubleshooting, leadership, and jobsite problem-solving abilities.
    • Ability to train and direct apprentices or installation helpers.
    • Commitment to quality workmanship, safety, and code compliance.
    • Strong communication and customer service skills.
    • EPA Universal Certification required.
    • Applicable trade licenses or certifications preferred.
    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Work at Burns & McBride?

    • Competitive compensation based on experience
    • Performance-based earning opportunities
    • Steady, year-round installation demand
    • Strong office, warehouse, and operational support
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
    • Company-Provided Vehicle
    • Company Phone or Tablet
    • Uniforms Provided
    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Leadership Training
    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means taking ownership of each installation, delivering clean and dependable workmanship, and ensuring every system operates correctly before the job is complete. You’ll set the standard for the installation team, develop less-experienced employees, and help Burns & McBride continue earning customer trust through quality, professionalism, and consistent execution.

    You’ll have the opportunity to make decisions in the field, develop less-experienced team members, and deliver installations you’re proud to put your name on. With steady work, strong operational support, and opportunities to continue growing, Burns & McBride offers experienced installers a place to build the next stage of their careers.

    What You’ll Do

    • Lead residential HVAC replacement and installation projects from start to finish.
    • Install furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, mini-splits, thermostats, and indoor air quality equipment.
    • Complete ductwork modifications, refrigerant piping, condensate drainage, venting, gas piping, wiring, and system connections.
    • Direct, train, and support apprentices and installation helpers.
    • Perform equipment startups, charging, airflow verification, testing, and commissioning.
    • Troubleshoot installation issues and ensure work meets manufacturer requirements, applicable codes, and company standards.
    • Review job information and communicate equipment, material, or scope concerns promptly.
    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, safe, and professional jobsite.
    • Explain system operation, maintenance expectations, and warranty information to homeowners.
    • Complete accurate job documentation, equipment records, and required photos.
    • Coordinate with sales, service, dispatch, warehouse, and leadership teams.
    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, equipment, materials, and inventory.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous experience leading residential HVAC replacement and installation projects.
    • Ability to independently complete residential HVAC installations from start to finish.
    • Strong knowledge of heating and cooling equipment, ductwork, refrigeration, airflow, venting, and system commissioning.
    • Strong troubleshooting, leadership, and jobsite problem-solving abilities.
    • Ability to train and direct apprentices or installation helpers.
    • Commitment to quality workmanship, safety, and code compliance.
    • Strong communication and customer service skills.
    • EPA Universal Certification required.
    • Applicable trade licenses or certifications preferred.
    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Work at Burns & McBride?

    • Competitive compensation based on experience
    • Performance-based earning opportunities
    • Steady, year-round installation demand
    • Strong office, warehouse, and operational support
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
    • Company-Provided Vehicle
    • Company Phone or Tablet
    • Uniforms Provided
    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Leadership Training
    • Career Advancement Opportunities
    • The opportunity to train and develop future HVAC professionals
    • A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means taking ownership of each installation, delivering clean and dependable workmanship, and ensuring every system operates correctly before the job is complete. You’ll set the standard for the installation team, develop less-experienced employees, and help Burns & McBride continue earning customer trust through quality, professionalism, and consistent execution.

    Lead HVAC Installer

    Absolute Air Services | Portland, CT

    A great Lead HVAC Installer does more than install equipment. They take ownership of the job, solve challenges in the field, develop the people working beside them, and leave every homeowner confident that the work was done right.

    At Absolute Air Services, we’re looking for an experienced Lead HVAC Installer who takes pride in exceptional craftsmanship and wants to work for a company that recognizes the value of skilled tradespeople.     • Strong knowledge of residential HVAC equipment, ductwork, refrigeration, airflow, venting, and system commissioning.

    • Strong troubleshooting, leadership, and jobsite problem-solving skills.

    • Ability to train and direct apprentices or installation helpers.

    • Commitment to quality workmanship, safety, and code compliance.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • EPA Universal Certification required.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.

    Compensation and Benefits

    • Competitive compensation based on experience.

    • Performance-based earning opportunities.

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Vehicle

    • Company Phone or Tablet

    • Uniforms Provided

    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Leadership Training

    • Year-Round Work

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means taking ownership of every installation, delivering clean and dependable workmanship, and ensuring systems operate correctly before leaving the customer’s home. You’ll set the standard for the installation team, develop less-experienced employees, and help Absolute Air Services earn lasting customer trust through quality, professionalism, and attention to detail.

    Master Electrician

    Absolute Air Services | Portland, CT

    Absolute Air Services is growing its residential electrical business, and we’re looking for an experienced E-1 Licensed Master Electrician who wants to stay hands-on in the field while taking on more responsibility over time.

    This is first and foremost a working electrician role. You’ll run residential service calls, complete repairs and upgrades, solve complex electrical issues, and provide customers with professional recommendations.

    Because of your experience and E-1 license, you’ll also serve as a technical resource for the team, help support less-experienced electricians, and have the opportunity to take on additional leadership responsibility as the electrical department continues to grow.

    If you’re an experienced electrician who enjoys the field but wants a clear path toward greater influence, responsibility, and career growth, this could be a strong next step.

    Why Join Absolute Air Services?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities
    • Steady, year-round customer demand
    • Strong customer service, dispatch, and operational support
    • Company-Provided Vehicle
    • Company Tablet
    • Professional Tools and Equipment
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
    • Company-Provided Uniforms
    • Ongoing Technical and Leadership Training
    • Career Advancement Opportunities
    • Opportunity to help shape a growing residential electrical department

    What You’ll Do

    • Run residential electrical service and repair calls.
    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential electrical systems.
    • Install and replace panels, breakers, circuits, outlets, switches, lighting, ceiling fans, and related electrical components.
    • Complete service upgrades, wiring repairs, dedicated circuits, and electrical system improvements.
    • Install EV chargers, generators, surge protection, smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, and other residential electrical equipment.
    • Perform electrical safety inspections and identify code, performance, and safety concerns.
    • Explain findings and recommend appropriate repair or replacement options to homeowners.
    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and required documentation.
    • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional vehicle and work environment.
    • Serve as a technical resource for other electricians when complex issues arise.
    • Provide guidance and mentorship to apprentices and less-experienced electricians.
    • Help reinforce quality, safety, and code-compliance standards across the electrical team.
    • Support field leadership with technical questions, quality checks, and troubleshooting as needed.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Active Connecticut E-1 Electrical Contractor license required
    • Strong residential electrical service, repair, and installation experience
    • Strong knowledge of the National Electrical Code and Connecticut electrical requirements
    • Excellent diagnostic and troubleshooting skills
    • Ability to independently manage complex residential service calls
    • Strong customer service and communication skills
    • Ability to explain technical findings clearly to homeowners
    • Willingness to mentor and support less-experienced electricians
    • Previous lead, foreman, or mentoring experience is a plus, but not required
    • Interest in growing into additional leadership responsibility over time
    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, CRM systems, and field service software
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means being one of the strongest electricians on the team.

    You’ll consistently deliver quality work, solve difficult electrical problems, take care of customers, and become someone other electricians can rely on when they need technical guidance.

    As the electrical department grows, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility in areas such as mentoring, quality, training, and field leadership — without requiring you to immediately step away from the work you enjoy.

    If you’re an experienced E-1 electrician looking for a strong field opportunity today with room to grow into more tomorrow, we’d like to talk to you.

    Master Plumber

    Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical | Norwalk, CT

    You’ve spent years mastering your trade. The right next opportunity should give you the ability to continue doing the work you’re great at while also giving your experience a greater influence on the people and work around you.

    Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical is looking for an experienced Master Plumber to join our team in Norwalk, CT. Because our plumbing work extends across both Connecticut and neighboring New York markets, our ideal candidate holds an active Connecticut P-1 license along with Master Plumber licensing that supports work in Westchester County, NY. Putnam County licensing is an additional plus.

    This is a hands-on position for an accomplished plumber who still wants to work in the field. You’ll run residential plumbing calls, diagnose and complete complex work, and remain productive while also serving as a trusted technical resource for the plumbers around you.

    Your experience will help set the standard for workmanship, code compliance, safety, troubleshooting, and customer service across the plumbing team.

    If you’re looking for an opportunity where your license, technical expertise, and leadership ability are truly valued, Astacio may be the right place for your next move.

    Why Join Astacio?

    • Competitive compensation based on experience and licensing

    • High Quality and Affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Steady, year-round residential customer demand

    • Company-provided vehicle, gas card, uniforms, and tablet

    • Ongoing Technical and Professional Development

    • Career advancement within one of the largest home services companies is the US!

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, repair, replace, and install residential plumbing systems.

    • Complete plumbing, drain, water heater, piping, fixture, pump, valve, and related service work.

    • Handle complex plumbing calls and provide technical guidance when other plumbers need support.

    • Perform work in accordance with applicable Connecticut and New York plumbing codes, permitting requirements, and manufacturer specifications.

    • Serve as a plumbing subject matter expert and resource for technicians in the field.

    • Help establish and maintain high standards for workmanship, safety, code compliance, and customer service.

    • Review challenging jobs, callbacks, or quality concerns and help determine appropriate solutions.

    • Perform field quality checks and provide coaching when opportunities for improvement are identified.

    • Mentor apprentices and experienced plumbers to strengthen their technical skills and diagnostic abilities.

    • Participate in interviewing and evaluating prospective plumbing team members.

    • Provide ongoing feedback to help ensure plumbers meet expectations for productivity, workmanship, professionalism, and customer care.

    • Lead by example while continuing to run productive residential service calls.

    • Clearly explain diagnoses and available repair or replacement options to homeowners.

    • Obtain customer authorization before beginning work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate estimates, invoices, service notes, photos, and required documentation.

    • Maintain a clean, organized, properly stocked company vehicle.

    • Communicate parts, scheduling, permitting, or return-trip needs promptly.

    • Work closely with dispatch, customer service, warehouse, and location leadership to keep work moving efficiently.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Active Connecticut P-1 Plumbing & Piping Contractor license strongly preferred.

    • Master Plumber licensing that supports work in Westchester County, New York strongly preferred.

    • Putnam County, NY licensing is a plus.

    • Extensive residential plumbing service, repair, and installation experience.

    • Strong knowledge of plumbing codes, permitting requirements, and residential plumbing systems.

    • Ability to independently diagnose and complete complex plumbing work.

    • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving ability.

    • Ability to coach, mentor, and provide constructive feedback to other plumbers.

    • Previous experience providing field leadership or overseeing the work of other technicians preferred.

    • Ability to evaluate workmanship and identify safety, code, or quality concerns.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Confidence explaining technical findings and appropriate solutions to homeowners.

    • Professional judgment and the ability to lead by example.

    • Strong organization and documentation skills.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field-service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means being one of the people Astacio can count on when the plumbing work is difficult, the technical answer isn’t obvious, or another plumber needs guidance.

    You’ll continue producing in the field while helping raise the performance of the team around you. Your work will set the example for quality, safety, code compliance, professionalism, and customer care.

    You’ll help develop other plumbers, support strong hiring decisions, reduce callbacks and quality issues, and ensure our customers receive plumbing work that meets the standards expected from Astacio.

    Ready for What’s Next?

    If you’re an experienced Master Plumber who still enjoys working in the field but is ready to have a greater impact through your experience, licensing, and leadership, we want to talk to you.

    Apply today and bring your expertise to Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical.

    Multi-Site Sales Manager

    Greater Hartford, CT Market

    You've already proven you can build one great sales team. Now imagine doing it across two — same market, two locations, one connected strategy and your fingerprints on every win. That's the opportunity in front of you.

    We're expanding our leadership bench in the Greater Hartford, CT market, and we're looking for a Multi-Site Sales Manager to take the reins across two local branch locations. This isn't a caretaker role — it's a builder role. You'll inherit a foundation of strong local teams and be the one who turns them into a single, high-performing sales force with a shared playbook, shared standards and a shared hunger to win.

    We're a trusted name in residential heating, cooling, and electrical solutions, built on long-term relationships with homeowners and a reputation for getting it right. As we grow our presence in this market, we need a leader who can scale that reputation across both locations — without losing what makes it work.

    Compensation & Benefits

    Compensation: Base salary (based on experience and scope of locations managed) + commission and bonus plan.

    Total Pay: $120,000–$220,000 per year (Base + Commission + Bonus)

    • 401(k)

    • Company car

    • Dental insurance

    • Employee discount

    • Health insurance

    • Paid time off

    • Parental leave

    • Tuition reimbursement

    • Vision insurance

    • Quarterly bonus

    The Opportunity

    As Multi-Site Sales Manager, you'll own sales performance for two branch locations in the same Greater Hartford market. Think of yourself as the connective tissue between two teams that are great on their own but even better working from the same game plan. You'll split your time across both locations — coaching in the field, calibrating standards in the conference room, and reporting on results at the business level.

    This role is built for someone who wants scale and significance — a bigger book of business, a bigger team to develop, and a direct line to the kind of revenue impact that gets noticed at the top of the company.

    What You'll Do

    • Lead, coach, and hold accountable comfort advisors and outside sales reps across two branch locations in the Greater Hartford market.

    • Build one consistent sales playbook — process, messaging, and standards — that works seamlessly at both locations while still flexing to each site's local dynamics.

    • Drive revenue growth through in-field ride-alongs, live coaching, and performance management at both locations.

    • Recruit, hire, and develop the next generation of sales talent and team leads, building bench strength at each site.

    • Monitor KPIs, close rates, and sales metrics location-by-location — spotting what's working at your stronger site and replicating it at the other.

    • Partner with branch GMs and operations leaders at each location to align sales capacity with install and service capacity.

    • Develop and execute sales strategy and growth initiatives across both locations to expand market share in Greater Hartford.

    • Prepare and manage sales budgets and projections across both P&Ls, and approve expenditures within your authority.

    • Set the tone on customer experience — make sure every homeowner at either location gets the same tailored, trustworthy experience.

    • Step in personally to resolve escalated customer concerns when a deal or relationship needs a senior hand.

    What You Bring

    • 5+ years of in-home or residential sales experience, with 3–5 years leading a sales team (experience leading teams across more than one location strongly preferred).

    • A track record of setting aggressive sales targets and actually hitting them — not just setting them.

    • Comfort managing through layers — coaching team leads who coach reps — rather than only managing individuals directly.

    • Strong CRM fluency using ServiceTitan for pipeline management and forecasting across two locations.

    • Sharp analytical instincts: you can look at sales data from two branches and immediately see the story it's telling.

    • A willingness to split your week between two branch locations within the Greater Hartford market.

    • Planning, organization, and problem-solving skills that hold up when you're juggling two sites' priorities at once.

    • Residential HVAC, plumbing, or electrical industry experience is important.

    You'll Thrive in This Role If You're...

    • Self-motivated and energized by ownership, not just oversight.

    • Assertive, competitive, and genuinely uncomfortable with “good enough.”

    • Outgoing and persuasive one-on-one, with the presence to win a room of reps or a room of GMs.

    • Highly organized, with the follow-through to keep multiple branches on track at once.

    • Someone who treats honesty and customer trust as non-negotiable, even under pressure to close.

    Schedule & Location

    • Schedule: Monday–Friday, day shift, with weekends as needed and regular travel between the two branch locations.

    • Work Location: On-site, split between two branch locations within the Greater Hartford, CT market.

    • Job Type: Full-time

    At Sila Boston, we take care of our people, invest in great tools and training, and give our techs real opportunities to grow and make great money. You’ll have steady work, a strong team behind you, and the resources of a growing company — without losing that local team feel.

    We're proud to be an official partner of the Boston Bruins! Our partnership reflects our commitment to teamwork, excellence, and being part of the Boston community.

     

    We're looking for an experienced Oil Service Technician who takes pride in quality workmanship, enjoys solving problems, and is committed to delivering excellent customer service.

    • Competitive compensation with weekly pay

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Perform preventative maintenance, annual tune-ups, and safety inspections.

    • Service and repair common oil burner systems, including Beckett, Riello, and Carlin.

    • Test and adjust heating equipment to ensure safe, efficient operation.

    • Identify potential system issues and recommend appropriate repairs or upgrades.

    • Clearly communicate findings and service recommendations to homeowners.

    • Complete accurate service documentation and follow all Massachusetts safety codes and regulations.

    • 2+ years of experience servicing and repairing residential oil-fired heating systems.

    Residential Service Plumber

    JSP Home Services | Kingston, NY

    At JSP Home Services, we’re looking for an experienced Residential Service Plumber who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, dependable workmanship, and creating a professional customer experience. You’ll have the support of a knowledgeable dispatch and operations team, the resources needed to work efficiently, and opportunities to continue growing your skills and earning potential.

    As a Residential Service Plumber, you’ll diagnose, repair, and improve residential plumbing systems while helping homeowners understand their options and make informed decisions. You’ll take ownership of your service calls while working with an experienced home services team committed to delivering dependable results.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, repair, and maintain residential plumbing systems.

    • Service and install water heaters, faucets, toilets, fixtures, disposals, sump pumps, ejector pumps, and related equipment.

    • Repair water lines, drain lines, leaks, valves, piping, and other plumbing components.

    • Perform plumbing inspections and identify code, safety, or performance concerns.

    • Clearly explain findings and recommend appropriate repair or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and follow-up documentation.

    • Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, materials, and truck inventory.

    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, and other field teams.

    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential plumbing service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Knowledge of residential plumbing systems, fixtures, materials, and applicable codes.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.

    • Comfortable presenting service options and making appropriate recommendations.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work.

    • Journeyman Plumber license or equivalent experience preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in basements, crawl spaces, bathrooms, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Work at JSP Home Services?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Vehicle

    • Company Phone or Tablet

    • Uniforms and Professional Tools

    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Customer Service Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Support from an experienced plumbing, HVAC, and electrical team

    • A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing plumbing problems accurately, completing dependable repairs and installations, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll communicate professionally, document your work thoroughly, and help JSP Home Services continue earning customer trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.

    Join Our Team!

    If you’re looking for year-round work, strong operational support, and a company that values quality, accountability, and doing the job right, JSP Home Services may be the right place for your next move.

    We're currently seeking skilled plumbing Apprentices to join our tight-knit family. At A to Z.     Job description:
    • Plumbing Apprentice - A to Z Dependable Services
    • We're currently seeking skilled Plumbers to join our tight-knit family. at A to Z. As a Plumber on our team, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your expertise, tackle exciting projects, and make a real difference in the lives of our customers. From installing plumbing systems to diagnosing and fixing issues and everything in between, you'll be at the forefront of delivering top-notch plumbing services that our customers can rely on.
    • As a Plumbing Apprentice at A to Z, you will play a pivotal role in our mission to provide unparalleled plumbing solutions that prioritize the well-being and satisfaction of our customers. Your technical expertise, dedication to excellence, and customer-centric approach will contribute to our commitment to delivering exceptional residential plumbing services.
    • We are currently looking for a Residential Plumbing Apprentice to efficiently undertake a variety of plumbing tasks ranging from fixing leakages to installing pipes and HVAC systems.
    Pay: $17-20/hr plus incentives!
     
    Benefits:
    • Health, dental & vision insurance
    • Paid vacation, sick and personal days
    • Short term disability, long term disability, and company paid life insurance
    • Paid training/ongoing education
    • Uniforms, tablet, and company vehicle.
     
    Responsibilities
    • Read blueprints and drawings to understand or plan the layout of plumbing, waste disposal and water supply systems
    • Cut, assemble and install pipes and tubes with attention to existing infrastructure (e.g. electrical wiring)
    • Install and maintain water supply systems
    • Locate and repair issues with water supply lines (e.g. leaks)
    • Repair or replace broken drainage lines, clogged drains, faucets etc.
    • Repair domestic appliances (e.g. washing machines) and fixtures (e.g. sinks) etc.
    • Install and maintain gas and liquid heating systems (air-conditioning units, radiators etc.)
    • Install waste disposal and sanitary systems with well-functioning DWV systems
     
    Skills and/or Qualifications:
    • Diploma from a trade school preferred
    • Ability to handle plumbing tools and equipment (pipe wrenches, pipe cutters, plungers etc.)
    • Good communication and interpersonal skills
    • Strong work ethic
    • Friendly with a great deal of patience

    • Valid driver's license preferred.
    • Reliable transportation and dependable attendance.
    • Willing to work outdoors in changing weather conditions.
    • Able to follow directions and work effectively as part of a two-person or larger crew.

    • Ensure all work is completed safely and meets local code requirements
    • Maintain a clean and professional appearance at all times
    • Deliver an exceptional customer experience on every call

    Qualifications

    • 3+ years of residential plumbing experience preferred
    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities
    • Experience with residential service, repair, and replacement work
    • Excellent customer service and communication skills
    • Ability to build trust and educate homeowners
    • Team-oriented attitude with a strong work ethic
    • Desire to learn, grow, and continuously improve
    • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
    • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening

    What We Offer

    • Competitive compensation
    • Performance-based incentives
    • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
    • Paid time off and paid holidays
    • 401(k) with company match
    • Company vehicle and equipment
    • Ongoing training and career development
    • Advancement opportunities within a growing company
    • Year-round work

    Join Our Team

    If you're looking for a company that values teamwork, growth, customer service, and having fun while delivering excellent results, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and grow with Carter's Plumbing, Heating & Cooling.

    Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric | Lynchburg, VA

    Bring Your Plumbing Skills to a Team That Backs You

    At Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric, our plumbers are trusted to solve problems that directly impact the safety, comfort, and daily lives of our customers.

    • Participate in ongoing technical, safety, and customer-service training.

    • 3+ years of residential plumbing service experience preferred.
    • Strong diagnostic and repair skills.
    • Knowledge of residential plumbing systems and applicable codes.
    • Strong customer service and communication skills.
    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.
    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality workmanship.
    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    Why Work at Davis?

    • Competitive compensation and advancement opportunities
    • Steady, year-round customer demand
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    You’ll help Davis continue building long-term customer relationships through quality service and consistent follow-through.

    Residential Service Plumber

    Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric | Danville, VA

    Bring Your Plumbing Skills to a Team That Backs You

    At Davis Heating, Cooling, Plumbing & Electric, our plumbers are trusted to solve problems that directly impact the safety, comfort, and daily lives of our customers.

    We’re looking for experienced Residential Service Plumbers who can diagnose issues, communicate clearly, and complete dependable repairs while providing a professional in-home experience.

    With multiple service locations across Southside Virginia and the Roanoke region, Davis provides plumbers with steady customer demand, strong operational support, continued training, and opportunities to build a long-term career.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential plumbing systems.
    • Repair and replace water heaters, fixtures, faucets, toilets, valves, piping, and related components.
    • Diagnose leaks, water-pressure issues, drainage problems, and other plumbing concerns.
    • Perform plumbing system inspections and identify safety, code, or performance issues.
    • Explain findings and available repair or replacement options clearly to homeowners.
    • Complete repairs safely and according to applicable plumbing codes and company standards.
    • Identify opportunities for upgrades or additional plumbing solutions when appropriate.
    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and required documentation.
    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.
    • Maintain assigned tools, equipment, vehicle, and truck inventory.
    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, drain technicians, and other field teams.
    • Participate in ongoing technical, safety, and customer-service training.

    What We’re Looking For

    • 3+ years of residential plumbing service experience preferred.
    • Strong diagnostic and repair skills.
    • Knowledge of residential plumbing systems and applicable codes.
    • Strong customer service and communication skills.
    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.
    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality workmanship.
    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    Why Work at Davis?

    • Competitive compensation and advancement opportunities
    • Steady, year-round customer demand
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • Retirement Plan with Company Match
    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
    • Company Vehicle for qualified field roles
    • Tool Account Program
    • Uniforms and major equipment provided
    • Ongoing technical training
    • Leadership development opportunities
    • Team-oriented environment where strong performance is recognized

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means solving plumbing problems correctly, communicating clearly with customers, and completing work that you can stand behind.

    You’ll help Davis continue building long-term customer relationships through quality service and consistent follow-through.
