    Proposal Administrator

    Allied Experts | Cherry Hill, NJ

    Position Summary

    Allied Experts is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Proposal Administrator to join our growing team. This position serves as the company's internal building performance expert, responsible for transforming home energy audits and field-collected data into comprehensive project proposals that improve a home's comfort, safety, health, durability, and energy efficiency.

    The Proposal Administrator plays a critical role in the customer journey by analyzing building performance data, designing solutions, creating accurate project proposals, performing energy modeling, developing HVAC system designs, coordinating equipment selections, and maximizing available rebates and financing opportunities for homeowners.

    This position requires a unique blend of technical knowledge, critical thinking, project design, data analysis, and customer-focused problem solving.

    Benefits

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Company-Paid Life Insurance
    • Ongoing Training and Professional Development
    • Opportunities for Career Advancement and Future Growth
    • Paid Time Off and Holidays

    Essential Functions & Responsibilities

    • Develop accurate residential and commercial project proposals based on energy audits, building performance data, and customer needs.
    • Analyze and model project opportunities to improve home comfort, safety, health, durability, and energy efficiency.
    • Design HVAC and weatherization solutions that align with program requirements, customer goals, and company profitability targets.
    • Review audits for completeness and accuracy while providing feedback to Building Analysts and Auditors.
    • Coordinate with internal departments to ensure proper project design, equipment selection, and pricing.
    • Maximize available rebates, incentives, and financing opportunities for customers.
    • Prepare and submit project documentation to utility and rebate programs for approval and reimbursement.
    • Monitor proposal performance, win rates, and project margins while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
    • Maintain accurate project records and ensure compliance with program requirements and company standards.

    Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

    • Complete all assigned proposals and submissions within established timelines.
    • Maintain a high level of proposal accuracy and quality.
    • Achieve targeted gross margin goals on residential projects.
    • Ensure timely and accurate utility program submissions.
    • Review completed audits and provide actionable feedback to auditors.
    • Develop accurate Manual J calculations and HVAC system designs.
    • Effectively incorporate mechanical and weatherization considerations into project recommendations.
    • Monitor and improve proposal conversion rates and win/loss performance.

    Qualifications

    Required

    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
    • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational abilities.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
    • Ability to interpret technical information and translate it into customer-focused solutions.
    • Strong time management and project management skills.
    • Advanced computer proficiency.

    Preferred

    • Experience with residential energy efficiency, weatherization, HVAC, or home performance programs.
    • Experience performing Manual J calculations and HVAC system design.
    • Working knowledge of Zoho, ServiceTitan, Snugg, or similar software platforms.
    • Understanding of utility rebate programs, financing options, and energy efficiency incentives.
    • Experience developing proposals, estimates, or project designs.

    Position Type & Schedule

    • Full-Time
    • Monday through Friday
    • 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM

    Regional Controller - King of Prussia, PA

    At Sila Services, we're more than just a growing home services company — we're a team committed to supporting our people, delivering exceptional service, and creating opportunities for long-term career growth. With a strong network of trusted local brands, we combine the resources of a larger organization with the values and culture of the communities we serve. We believe in investing in our employees, encouraging collaboration, and providing the tools and support needed to succeed.

    The Regional Controller oversees financial reporting, controllership, and accounting operations across assigned business units, partnering closely with Regional Vice Presidents, General Managers, and Senior Accountants to ensure accurate reporting, strong internal controls, and timely month-end close processes.

    This role provides technical expertise in US GAAP and accounting systems while leading and developing accounting teams, supporting operational performance, and driving strategic initiatives. The Regional Controller is accountable for both team performance and financial results, proactively identifying issues, strengthening operational partnerships, and ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of the team's work.

    What We Offer

    • Competitive compensation: $135,000 with weekly pay!

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Paid Life and Disability Insurance

    • Ongoing Training and Professional Development

    • Career Growth Opportunities

    • Employee Discounts

    What You'll Do

    Team Leadership & Development

    • Provide coaching, mentoring, and professional development support to regional accounting staff, identifying strengths and gaps, building development plans, and providing regular, honest feedback.

    • Train team members in accounting processes, systems, and best practices while delegating effectively and building bench strength across the region.

    • Take accountability for individual and broader team issues, helping the team adapt to changing situations and priorities.

    • Proactively gather, validate, and evaluate relevant internal and external data, challenging assumptions and incorporating different perspectives to build informed team recommendations.

    Financial Reporting & Controllership

    • Oversee monthly financial reviews, balance sheet analysis, account reconciliations, and controllership activities for assigned locations.

    • Monitor financial performance, investigate variances, and recommend corrective actions while anticipating issues before they reach leadership.

    • Review and support month-end close activities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting and accountability for the entire team's output.

    • Serve as the primary reviewer of financial statements for assigned brands and locations, ensuring effective and timely completion of work.

    • Prepare financial statements and reporting packages when staffing coverage or business needs require.

    • Review and own reconciliations for assigned locations, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.

    • Support consolidated reconciliations and other complex accounting analyses.

    • Apply US GAAP in an operational setting, making sound technical judgments, guiding accounting treatment, and researching or escalating complex accounting matters when necessary.

    Operational & Financial Partnership

    • Serve as the primary financial liaison between accounting teams, Regional Vice Presidents, General Managers, and local leadership.

    • Own relationships with operational leadership and accountability for regional site performance, translating financial results into business context to drive improvements.

    • Partner with site leadership to identify operational and financial issues and develop corrective action plans.

    • Conduct ongoing controllership activities with locations, including follow-up on open items, performance concerns, and financial trends.

    • Provide timely upward feedback to department leadership regarding errors, issues, root causes, and remediation.

    • Analyze inventory, material, and equipment-related variances and provide recommendations to management.

    Accounting Systems & Process Improvement

    • Support accounting teams with system-related issues, troubleshooting, and process improvements throughout the accounting cycle.

    • Maintain strong knowledge of ServiceTitan and Sage Intacct, along with proficiency in ancillary systems such as OneStream.

    • Train team members on accounting systems and identify opportunities to improve processes and efficiencies.

    • Monitor pending payments and unresolved ServiceTitan items, escalating issues as needed.

    • Review outstanding bank reconciliation items and assist with research, exports, and resolution of differences.

    Inventory Management

    • Coordinate and oversee year-end inventory counts, including planning meetings, monitoring progress, reviewing extended costing, and preparing final inventory results.

    • Investigate inventory discrepancies and partner with operational teams to ensure inventory accuracy.

    Special Projects

    • Lead and support strategic initiatives, including mergers, acquisitions, integrations, and other finance-related projects.

    • Provide regular project updates to department leadership, bringing solutions alongside problems and considering downstream impacts across teams, systems, and reporting.

    • Participate in ad hoc financial analyses and special assignments requested by senior leadership.

    What We're Looking For

    • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

    • Progressive accounting and financial management experience.

    • Strong knowledge of financial reporting, account reconciliations, internal controls, month-end close processes, and US GAAP.

    • Ability to apply US GAAP guidance independently in an operational business environment.

    • Strong understanding of ServiceTitan and Sage Intacct preferred, with proficiency in ancillary systems such as OneStream.

    • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.

    • Strong communication and business partnering abilities, including experience working with department and cross-functional leadership.

    • Ability to translate accounting results into meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations.

    • Proven leadership, coaching, and team development experience, including creating development plans, delegating effectively, and providing constructive feedback.

    • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities across multiple business units.

    Join Our Team!

    We're looking for a results-driven Regional Controller who combines strong technical accounting expertise with exceptional leadership and business partnership skills.

    If you're passionate about developing teams, improving financial performance, and making a meaningful impact across a growing organization, we encourage you to apply today!

    Residential Service Electrician

    Jones Services | Hudson Valley, NY

    Great electricians have options. At Jones Services, we offer more than another service truck and a full schedule—we provide the earning potential, training, support, and career opportunities experienced professionals need to build something long term.

    Our Residential Service Electricians benefit from industry-leading compensation, steady customer demand, and no on-call responsibilities.

    Jones Services is a leading HVAC, plumbing, and electrical employer serving homeowners throughout the Hudson Valley. We’ve created a workplace where skilled professionals receive the resources, training, and support needed to perform at their best and advance their careers.

    If you’re an experienced electrician who enjoys solving problems, helping homeowners, and being rewarded for strong performance, we want to talk to you.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential electrical systems.

    • Install and replace panels, breakers, circuits, outlets, switches, lighting, ceiling fans, and other electrical components.

    • Complete service upgrades, wiring repairs, dedicated circuits, and electrical system improvements.

    • Install generators, EV chargers, surge protection, smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, and other residential electrical equipment.

    • Perform electrical safety inspections and identify code, safety, and performance concerns.

    • Clearly explain findings and present homeowners with appropriate service options.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and customer documentation.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, safe, and professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, materials, and truck inventory.

    • Coordinate with customer service, dispatch, and other field teams.

    • Participate in ongoing technical, safety, sales, and customer service training.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential electrical service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Knowledge of residential wiring methods, electrical systems, and the National Electrical Code.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication, presentation, and customer service skills.

    • Comfortable explaining options and recommending appropriate solutions to homeowners.

    • Self-motivated, dependable, and driven to achieve performance goals.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality workmanship.

    • Applicable electrical license or local credentials preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Jones Services?

    We feel a personal responsibility to the people who choose to build their careers with us. Our goal is to create a supportive workplace where every team member has the opportunity to develop their skills, increase their earning potential, and advance within the company.

    We don’t look only at years of experience. We look for professionals with the right attitude, ambition, and commitment to excellence. When we find those qualities, we invest in the training and support needed to help that person succeed.

    Compensation and Benefits

    • Industry-leading compensation

    • Average electrician earnings of approximately $85,000–$125,000

    • Top electrician earnings of approximately $150,000–$200,000

    • No on-call responsibilities

    • Company vehicle and gas card

    • Company-provided cell phone and tablet

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • Health Savings Account with Company Contributions

    • Company-Paid Short-Term Disability Insurance

    • Company-Paid Long-Term Disability Insurance

    • Company-Paid Life Insurance

    • Paid Holidays

    • Paid Time Off

    • Parental Leave

    • Tuition Reimbursement

    • Tool Account

    • Safety Shoe Reimbursement

    • Employee discounts on services and entertainment

    • Friends and family discounts on company services

    • Annual Performance Reviews

    • Ongoing Training and Career Development

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing electrical problems accurately, delivering safe and dependable work, and helping homeowners make informed decisions. You’ll create an exceptional customer experience, take ownership of your results, and benefit from a company that recognizes and rewards strong performance.

    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while protecting customers' homes.

    • Strong knowledge of residential electrical systems, wiring methods, troubleshooting, and repairs.

    • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.

    • Excellent customer service and communication abilities.

    • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

    Success in this role means delivering safe, high-quality electrical work, solving customer problems efficiently, building trust with homeowners, and contributing to Triangle's reputation for exceptional service and craftsmanship.     HVAC Service Technician

    Jones Services | Hudson Valley, NY

    Earn More. Keep Your Evenings. Build Your Future with Jones Services.

    Experienced HVAC technicians have options. At Jones Services, we offer more than a full schedule and another service truck—we provide industry-leading earning potential, steady customer demand, strong operational support, and a schedule that protects your personal time.

    There is no on-call rotation—ever. When your scheduled workday ends, your time belongs to you.

    Our HVAC Service Technicians typically earn $85,000 to $125,000 in total annual pay, while our top-performing technicians earn $150,000 to $200,000—and so can you.

    Jones Services is one of the Hudson Valley’s leading HVAC, plumbing, and electrical employers. We’ve built a workplace where technicians receive the tools, resources, and support needed to perform at their best. You’ll have a knowledgeable dispatch and customer service team behind you, continued technical and customer service training, and opportunities to increase both your skills and earning potential.

    If you’re an experienced technician who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, dependable repairs, and helping homeowners make informed decisions—without sacrificing your nights to an on-call schedule—Jones Services may be the right place for your next move.

    We don’t just offer jobs—we build careers. Here’s why you’ll love being part of the JOnesteam:

    • Industry-Leading Compensation: Ranging from $25 - $45/hour, our technicians earned an average of $85k–$125K in 2025. Top performers made between $150k–$200k — and so can you!
    • Paid Time Off : Begin accruing paid time off from your first day on the job.
    • Sign-on Bonus Up to $5,000: We value your experience and are ready to invest in you right away.
    • Relocation Assistance: Up to $5,000 in relocation support is available for experienced Service Technicians to help you make a smooth transition.
    • Fully Stocked Warehouse & Parts Runners: Get the support you need with ready access to parts and a stocked facility.
    • Clean, Fully Stocked Truck: Hit the road in a company-provided vehicle equipped with the tools you need.
    • Comprehensive Health Benefits: Affordable, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family.
    • 401(k) Plan with Company Match: Invest in your future with our competitive retirement plan and company contribution.
    • Parental Leave: We support you through all stages of life, including paid parental leave.
    • Tool and Boot Allowance: Invest in your future and safety with an annual tool and boot support.
    • Training and Development Opportunities: Advance your skills with professional training with Sila University. Virtual Reality training and our own internal training database, SPARC. Learn technical systems, customer service, oil service, and more.
    • Yearly Performance Reviews: We support your career development with regular performance evaluations and opportunities for growth.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, service, repair, and maintain residential heating and cooling systems.

    • Service furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, air handlers, thermostats, and indoor air quality equipment.

    • Troubleshoot electrical, refrigeration, airflow, mechanical, hydronic, combustion, and control-system issues.

    • Perform preventive maintenance, equipment startups, system testing, and safety inspections.

    • Clearly explain diagnosed problems and present appropriate repair, maintenance, or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate service notes, equipment records, estimates, photos, and follow-up documentation.

    • Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, safe, and professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, diagnostic tools, equipment, and truck inventory.

    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, installation, and management teams.

    • Participate in ongoing technical, safety, sales, and customer service training.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential HVAC service, repair, and maintenance experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Experience servicing furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, and related systems.

    • Knowledge of refrigeration, electrical, airflow, combustion, hydronic, and control systems.

    • Ability to manage service calls independently from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication, presentation, and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available solutions clearly to homeowners.

    • Comfortable recommending appropriate products and services based on customer needs.

    • Self-motivated, dependable, and driven to achieve performance goals.

    • Commitment to safe, dependable, and high-quality work.

    • EPA Universal Certification required.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, mechanical rooms, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Jones Services?

    We feel a personal responsibility to the people who choose to build their careers with us. Our goal is to create a supportive workplace where every employee has the opportunity to develop their skills, maximize their potential, and advance within the company.

    We don’t look only at years of experience. We look for professionals with the right attitude, ambition, and desire to succeed. When we find those qualities, we invest in the training, coaching, tools, and support needed to help that person excel.

    HVAC Service Technician

    Absolute Air Services | Portland, CT

    Pay: $30-48/hr plus uncapped incentives! (our techs make $100k+)

    A great HVAC Service Technician does more than repair equipment. They solve problems, earn homeowners’ trust, and provide the kind of service customers remember long after the call is complete.

    At Absolute Air Services, we’re looking for an experienced, Connecticut-licensed HVAC Service Technician who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, dependable repairs, and exceptional customer care. You’ll have steady, year-round work, strong support from the office and field teams, and the opportunity to continue developing your technical skills.

    You’ll diagnose and service residential heating and cooling systems, clearly explain your findings, and help homeowners make informed decisions about their comfort. If you’re looking for a company that values your expertise, supports your success, and recognizes quality work, we want to talk to you.

    We don't just offer jobs—we build careers. Here’s why you’ll love being part of our team:

    • Industry-Leading Compensation: We believe in rewarding excellence, which is why we offer compensation that provides six-figure earning potential!
    • Fully Stocked Warehouse & Parts Runners
    • Clean, Fully Stocked Truck
    • Comprehensive Health Benefits: We offer affordable, high-quality health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family covered.
    • Paid Time Off
    • 401(k) Plan with Company Match
    • Parental Leave: We support our team members through all stages of life, including offering parental leave for new parents.
    • Training and Development Opportunities: We’re committed to your professional growth and provide ongoing training.
    • Yearly Performance Reviews: We believe in continuous improvement and offer yearly performance reviews to ensure you’re on track and rewarded for your hard work.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential HVAC systems.

    • Service furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, air handlers, and indoor air quality equipment.

    • Identify electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, airflow, and combustion-related issues.

    • Perform system testing, maintenance, equipment startups, and safety inspections.

    • Explain findings and present homeowners with appropriate repair, maintenance, or replacement options.

    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, equipment records, and job documentation.

    • Ensure all work meets applicable codes, manufacturer specifications, and company standards.

    • Maintain a clean, organized work area and protect customers’ homes.

    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, installation, and management teams.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, equipment, and inventory.

    What We’re Looking For

    • An active Connecticut S-1, S-2, D-1, D-2, B-1, or B-2 license is required.

    • 3 or more years of residential HVAC service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills.

    • Knowledge of heating, cooling, refrigeration, electrical, airflow, and combustion systems.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work.

    • EPA Universal Certification required.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    Success in this role means diagnosing problems accurately, completing dependable repairs, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide.     Residential HVAC Service Technician

    Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical | Norwalk, CT

    Do Great Work with a Company That Supports You

    Experienced HVAC technicians have options. The difference is finding a company that respects your expertise, provides the support you need in the field, and gives you a real opportunity to grow.

    At Astacio Plumbing, Heating, Cooling & Electrical, our technicians are trusted professionals—not just another number on a schedule.     As a Residential HVAC Service Technician, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your calls, solve challenging problems, and build lasting relationships with homeowners.     If you’re looking for year-round work, strong earning potential, and a company that recognizes the value you bring to the field, Astacio may be the right place for your next move.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, service, repair, and maintain residential heating and cooling systems.
    • Work on furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, air handlers, and indoor air quality equipment.
    • Troubleshoot electrical, refrigeration, airflow, mechanical, hydronic, and combustion issues.
    • Perform maintenance, system testing, safety inspections, and equipment startups.
    • Explain diagnosed problems and recommend appropriate repair, maintenance, or replacement options.
    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.
    • Maintain accurate service notes, equipment records, and follow-up information.
    • Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.
    • Maintain a clean vehicle, organized inventory, and professional work area.
    • Support apprentices and participate in required meetings and technical training.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential HVAC service, repair, and maintenance experience.
    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.
    • Experience with furnaces, boilers, air conditioners, heat pumps, mini-splits, and related systems.
    • Knowledge of refrigeration, electrical, airflow, combustion, hydronic, and control systems.
    • Ability to manage service calls independently from diagnosis through completion.
    • Strong communication and customer service skills.
    • Professional judgment and respect for customers and their homes.
    • Ability to maintain complete and timely electronic service documentation.
    • EPA Universal Certification required.
    • Active Connecticut S-1, S-2, D-1, D-2, B-1, or B-2 license preferred.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    Why Work at Astacio?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities

    • Company Phone or Tablet
    • Uniforms and Professional Diagnostic Equipment
    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Customer Service Training
    • Opportunities for Career Advancement
    • The support of an established plumbing, HVAC, and electrical team
    • A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means solving problems accurately, delivering dependable repairs, and creating an experience that earns customers’ trust. You’ll be supported by a team that values your expertise, communicates clearly, and gives you the resources to perform at your best.

    TriState Home Services | Frederick, MD

    Experienced electricians have options. The right opportunity should offer more than a full schedule—it should provide steady customer demand, strong office support, quality tools, continued training, and a company that respects the expertise you bring into every home.

    At TriState Home Services, we provide heating, cooling, plumbing, drain, and electrical services to homeowners throughout the region. Our full-service structure creates consistent demand and gives our electricians the support of an experienced customer service, dispatch, and operations team.

    We’re looking for a skilled Residential Service Electrician who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, safe workmanship, and creating an exceptional customer experience. You’ll have the resources needed to work efficiently, take ownership of your service calls, and continue growing your technical skills and earning potential.

    If you’re looking for year-round work, strong operational support, and a company that values quality, accountability, and doing the job right, TriState Home Services may be the right place for your next move.

    Why Join TriState Home Services?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support

    • Company-provided vehicle

    • Company phone or tablet

    • Company-provided uniforms

    • Affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • Health Savings Account with Company Contributions

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Company-Paid Life Insurance

    • Company-Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

    • Paid Vacation, Sick Time, and Personal Days

    • Paid Holidays

    • Parental Leave

    • Tool and Safety Shoe Allowances

    • Ongoing Technical, Safety, and Customer Service Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Support from an experienced HVAC, plumbing, drain, and electrical team

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential electrical systems.

    • Install and replace panels, breakers, circuits, outlets, switches, lighting, ceiling fans, and related components.

    • Complete service upgrades, wiring repairs, dedicated circuits, and electrical system improvements.

    • Install EV chargers, generators, surge protection, smoke detectors, and other residential electrical equipment.

    • Perform electrical safety inspections and identify code, safety, and performance concerns.

    • Clearly explain findings and recommend appropriate repair or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer authorization before beginning work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and required documentation.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicle inventory, tools, equipment, and materials.

    • Coordinate with customer service, dispatch, and other field teams.

    • Participate in ongoing technical, safety, sales, and customer service training.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential electrical service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Knowledge of residential wiring methods, electrical systems, and the National Electrical Code.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication, presentation, and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.

    • Comfortable recommending appropriate solutions based on customer needs.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality workmanship.

    • Maryland Journeyman or Master Electrician license preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing electrical problems accurately, completing safe and dependable work, and helping homeowners feel confident in the solutions you recommend. You’ll take ownership of the customer experience, maintain professional communication, and help TriState Home Services continue earning trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.

    Ready for What’s Next?

    Join a company that provides the customer demand, resources, and support needed to grow your skills, earnings, and career. Apply today.

    At TriState Home Services, we provide heating, cooling, plumbing, drain, and electrical services to homeowners throughout the region. Our full-service structure creates consistent demand and gives our electricians the support of an experienced customer service, dispatch, and operations team.

    We’re looking for a skilled Residential Service Electrician who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, safe workmanship, and creating an exceptional customer experience. You’ll have the resources needed to work efficiently, take ownership of your service calls, and continue growing your technical skills and earning potential.

    If you’re looking for year-round work, strong operational support, and a company that values quality, accountability, and doing the job right, TriState Home Services may be the right place for your next move.

    Why Join TriState Home Services?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support

    • Company-provided vehicle

    • Company phone or tablet

    • Company-provided uniforms

    • Affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • Health Savings Account with Company Contributions

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Company-Paid Life Insurance

    • Company-Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

    • Paid Vacation, Sick Time, and Personal Days

    • Paid Holidays

    • Parental Leave

    • Tool and Safety Shoe Allowances

    • Ongoing Technical, Safety, and Customer Service Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Support from an experienced HVAC, plumbing, drain, and electrical team

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential electrical systems.

    • Install and replace panels, breakers, circuits, outlets, switches, lighting, ceiling fans, and related components.

    • Complete service upgrades, wiring repairs, dedicated circuits, and electrical system improvements.

    • Install EV chargers, generators, surge protection, smoke detectors, and other residential electrical equipment.

    • Perform electrical safety inspections and identify code, safety, and performance concerns.

    • Clearly explain findings and recommend appropriate repair or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer authorization before beginning work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and required documentation.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicle inventory, tools, equipment, and materials.

    • Coordinate with customer service, dispatch, and other field teams.

    • Participate in ongoing technical, safety, sales, and customer service training.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential electrical service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Knowledge of residential wiring methods, electrical systems, and the National Electrical Code.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication, presentation, and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.

    • Comfortable recommending appropriate solutions based on customer needs.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality workmanship.

    • Maryland Journeyman or Master Electrician license preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing electrical problems accurately, completing safe and dependable work, and helping homeowners feel confident in the solutions you recommend. You’ll take ownership of the customer experience, maintain professional communication, and help TriState Home Services continue earning trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.

    Ready for What’s Next?

    Join a company that provides the customer demand, resources, and support needed to grow your skills, earnings, and career. Apply today.

    • Knowledge of residential wiring methods, electrical systems, and the National Electrical Code.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work.
    • Journeyman Electrician license or equivalent experience preferred.

    Residential Service Electrician

    Guy Smith Home Services | Norfolk, VA

    Bring Your Skills to a Company That Backs Its Electricians

    Experienced electricians have options. The right opportunity should offer more than a full schedule—it should provide steady customer demand, strong support, quality tools, and a company that respects the expertise you bring into every home.

    At Guy Smith Home Services, we’re looking for an experienced Residential Service Electrician who takes pride in accurate diagnostics, safe workmanship, and creating a professional customer experience.     If you’re looking for year-round work, strong operational support, and a company that values quality, accountability, and doing the job right, Guy Smith Home Services may be the right place for your next move.

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain residential electrical systems.

    • Install and replace panels, breakers, circuits, outlets, switches, lighting, ceiling fans, and other electrical components.

    • Complete service upgrades, wiring repairs, dedicated circuits, and electrical system improvements.

    • Install EV chargers, generators, surge protection, smoke detectors, and other residential electrical equipment.

    • Perform electrical safety inspections and identify code, safety, or performance concerns.

    • Explain findings and recommend appropriate repair or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and follow-up documentation.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, materials, and truck inventory.

    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, and other field teams.

    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential electrical service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Knowledge of residential wiring methods, electrical systems, and the National Electrical Code.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work.

    • Virginia Journeyman or Master Electrician license preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in attics, basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Work at Guy Smith Home Services?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Vehicle

    • Company Phone or Tablet

    • Uniforms and Professional Tools

    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Customer Service Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Support from an experienced home services team

    • A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing electrical problems accurately, completing safe and dependable work, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll communicate professionally, document your work thoroughly, and help Guy Smith Home Services continue earning customer trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.

    Experienced plumbers have options. The right opportunity should offer more than a full schedule—it should provide steady customer demand, strong office support, quality tools, continued training, and a company that respects the expertise you bring into every home.

    If you’re looking for year-round work, strong operational support, and a company that values quality, accountability, and doing the job right, TriState Home Services may be the right place for your next move.

    Why Join TriState Home Services?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support

    • Company-provided vehicle

    • Company phone or tablet

    • Company-provided uniforms

    • Affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • Health Savings Account with Company Contributions

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Company-Paid Life Insurance

    • Company-Paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

    • Paid Vacation, Sick Time, and Personal Days

    • Paid Holidays

    • Parental Leave

    • Tool and Safety Shoe Allowances

    • Ongoing Technical, Safety, and Customer Service Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    • Support from an experienced HVAC, plumbing, drain, and electrical team

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, repair, and maintain residential plumbing systems.

    • Service and install water heaters, faucets, toilets, fixtures, disposals, sump pumps, ejector pumps, and related equipment.

    • Repair water lines, drain lines, leaks, valves, piping, and other plumbing components.

    • Perform plumbing inspections and identify code, safety, and performance concerns.

    • Clearly explain findings and recommend appropriate repair or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer authorization before beginning work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Complete accurate estimates, service notes, photos, and required documentation.

    • Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicle inventory, tools, equipment, and materials.

    • Coordinate with customer service, dispatch, and other field teams.

    • Participate in ongoing technical, safety, sales, and customer service training.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential plumbing service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Knowledge of residential plumbing systems, fixtures, materials, and applicable codes.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication, presentation, and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.

    • Comfortable recommending appropriate solutions based on customer needs.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality workmanship.

    • Maryland Journeyman or Master Plumber license preferred.

    • Backflow certification is a plus.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in basements, crawl spaces, bathrooms, and outdoor conditions.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing plumbing problems accurately, completing dependable repairs and installations, and helping homeowners feel confident in the solutions you recommend. You’ll take ownership of the customer experience, maintain professional communication, and help TriState Home Services continue earning trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.

    Ready for What’s Next?

    Join a company that provides the customer demand, resources, and support needed to grow your skills, earnings, and career. Apply today.

    Residential Service Plumber

    John Nugent & Sons | Sterling, VA

    Experienced plumbers should be rewarded for the value they bring to customers and the business. At John Nugent & Sons, this role offers a 100% performance-based commission structure, giving skilled, motivated plumbers the opportunity to directly influence their earnings through quality service, strong customer relationships, and consistent results.

    You won’t be expected to succeed on your own. You’ll have steady customer demand, strong dispatch and office support, an established local reputation, and the tools and resources needed to run productive service calls. Our team handles the scheduling and operational support so you can focus on diagnosing problems, presenting the right solutions, and delivering dependable work.

    As a Residential Service Plumber, you’ll take ownership of each customer interaction from diagnosis through completion. You’ll help homeowners understand their options, recommend solutions based on their needs, and provide the professional service that has kept Northern Virginia customers choosing John Nugent & Sons for generations.

    If you’re confident in your technical ability, comfortable discussing solutions with homeowners, and motivated by a compensation structure that rewards performance, this may be the right opportunity for your next move.

    Why Work at John Nugent & Sons?

    • 100% performance-based commission structure

    • Uncapped earning potential based on individual results

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support

    • High Quality & Affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Provided Vehicle and tablet

    • Ongoing Paid Technical, Sales, and Customer Service Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    What You’ll Do

    • Diagnose, repair, and maintain residential plumbing systems.

    • Service and install water heaters, faucets, toilets, fixtures, disposals, sump pumps, ejector pumps, and related equipment.

    • Repair water lines, drain lines, leaks, valves, piping, and other plumbing components.

    • Perform plumbing inspections and identify code, safety, and performance concerns.

    • Clearly explain findings and present appropriate repair or replacement options.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Prepare accurate estimates and complete service documentation using company software.

    • Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.

    • Maintain assigned vehicles, tools, materials, and truck inventory.

    • Coordinate with dispatch, customer service, and other field teams.

    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential plumbing service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Knowledge of residential plumbing systems, fixtures, materials, and applicable codes.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication, presentation, and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.

    • Comfortable recommending appropriate products and services based on customer needs.

    • Self-motivated and comfortable working within a performance-based compensation structure.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work.

    • Virginia Journeyman or Master Plumber license preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in basements, crawl spaces, bathrooms, and outdoor conditions.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing plumbing problems accurately, helping homeowners understand their options, and delivering dependable repairs and installations. You’ll build trust through honest recommendations, maintain a strong close rate without using high-pressure tactics, and take ownership of both the customer experience and your earning potential.

    Adam Home Services | Havertown, PA

    Bring Your Plumbing Expertise to a Company That Values Quality Work

    At Adam Home Services, we help homeowners throughout the Main Line and surrounding communities keep their homes comfortable, safe, and running reliably.     We’re looking for an experienced Residential Service Plumber who enjoys solving problems, working directly with homeowners, and being recognized for quality craftsmanship. You’ll have the support, tools, and customer demand needed to focus on doing great work and building a rewarding career.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.
    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.
    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work.
    • Journeyman Plumber license or equivalent experience preferred.
    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
    • Ability to perform physical work in basements, crawl spaces, and outdoor conditions.

    Compensation and Benefits

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities.
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
    • Company-Provided Vehicle
    • Company Phone or Tablet

    • Year-Round Work

    • Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment

You’ll deliver quality workmanship, build lasting customer relationships, and help Adam Home Services continue earning trust throughout the communities we serve.

    Service Coordinator

    At Sila Boston, we take care of our people, invest in great tools and training, and provide real opportunities to grow. You’ll have a strong team behind you and the resources of a growing company, without losing that local team feel.

    We're proud to be an official partner of the Boston Bruins! Our partnership reflects our commitment to teamwork, excellence, and being part of the Boston community.

    We're looking for an organized, detail-oriented, and customer-focused Service Coordinator to help keep our daily service operations running smoothly. In this role, you'll work closely with customers, technicians, dispatchers, and office teams to coordinate service requests, manage information, and ensure customers receive timely, professional support.

    The ideal candidate is comfortable juggling multiple priorities, communicates with empathy and professionalism, and knows how to keep things moving in a fast-paced environment. If you're a proactive problem-solver who enjoys supporting a team and delivering an exceptional customer experience, we'd love to hear from you!

    Compensation & Benefits

    • Competitive Compensation: $25–$35/hour

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

    • 401(k) with company match

    • Paid time off and paid holidays

    • Company-paid life and disability insurance

    • Paid training and professional development

    • Opportunities for career growth and advancement

     

    What You'll Do

    • Coordinate daily service activities and support scheduling for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical technicians

    • Communicate with customers regarding service appointments, updates, and follow-up needs

    • Utilize ServiceTitan to manage service requests, update customer records, and track job progress

    • Work closely with dispatchers, technicians, and office teams to ensure service calls are handled efficiently

    • Maintain accurate customer information, service notes, and job documentation

    • Manage multiple requests and priorities while ensuring timely follow-through

    • Handle customer concerns professionally, using empathy and effective de-escalation techniques

    • Assist with tracking parts availability, ordering materials, and coordinating with vendors as needed

    • Support warranty requests, estimates, deposits, and basic billing administration

    • Monitor outstanding service requests and follow up to help prevent delays

    • Identify potential scheduling or service issues and proactively communicate solutions

    • Escalate complex customer concerns or operational challenges to management when appropriate

    • Assist with administrative tasks and process improvements to support overall service efficiency

     

    What We're Looking For

    Required Qualifications

    • Experience with ServiceTitan required

    • Basic computer and software proficiency

    • Strong multitasking and prioritization skills in a fast-paced environment

    • Clear written and verbal communication skills

    • Excellent data entry accuracy and attention to detail

    • Ability to handle customer concerns with empathy, patience, and professionalism

    • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple responsibilities

    • Dependable, team-oriented, and committed to providing excellent customer service

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or another home services industry

    • Basic understanding of parts, tools, equipment, and repair processes

    • Inventory management and parts ordering experience, including checking stock levels, processing Return Merchandise Authorizations (RMAs), and tracking backordered shipments

    • Experience with warranty administration, estimates, deposits, and basic invoicing

    • Strong conflict resolution skills, including knowing when to offer approved solutions, expedite service requests, or escalate concerns to management

    • Ability to identify opportunities to improve processes and support efficient service operations

     

    What Success Looks Like

    • Keeps service requests organized, accurate, and moving forward efficiently

    • Communicates clearly and professionally with customers, technicians, and teammates

    • Maintains accurate information and documentation in ServiceTitan

    • Handles customer concerns calmly and works toward positive resolutions

    • Proactively identifies and resolves issues before they impact service delivery

    • Supports technicians and office teams in providing a smooth customer experience

    • Takes ownership of responsibilities and consistently follows through on commitments

     

    Join Our Team!

    If you're organized, tech-savvy, and enjoy helping customers while keeping a busy service team on track, we'd love to hear from you! Join a growing home services organization where your contributions make a difference every day.

    Oxford Plumbing & Heating has been serving its community for more than 75 years, building a loyal customer base through quality workmanship, honesty, and a commitment to doing right by the customer. We offer the best of both worlds: the personal feel of a small company with a supportive team, strong office support, and a genuine focus on our employees.

    We're looking for an experienced Service Plumber to join our team! If you take pride in your work and enjoy helping homeowners without the pressure of high-pressure sales, this could be a great fit. Our approach is simple: diagnose the problem, explain the options, and let the customer decide. You'll have the tools, support, and trust you need to do quality work and build lasting relationships with great customers.

    What Can We Do For You?

    • Competitive Compensation: $32–$45/hour, based on experience, plus bonus opportunities.

    • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

    • 401(k) with company match

    • Paid time off starting right away

    • Tool and boot allowance

    • Take-home company truck

    • Ongoing training and career growth opportunities

    • Strong commitment to work-life balance

     

    What You'll Do

    • Diagnose, repair, and maintain residential plumbing systems.

    • Repair and replace water heaters, fixtures, faucets, toilets, valves, piping, and related components.

    • Diagnose leaks, water-pressure problems, drainage issues, and other plumbing concerns.

    • Explain findings and repair or replacement options clearly to homeowners.

    • Complete work safely, cleanly, and according to applicable plumbing codes.

    • Provide honest recommendations without high-pressure sales tactics.

    • Complete accurate service notes and job documentation.

    • Maintain an organized truck, tools, and materials.

    • Work closely with dispatch, customer service, and other field team members.

    • Treat every customer's home with care and respect.

     

    What We're Looking For

    • 5+ years of residential plumbing service experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and repair skills.

    • Experience working directly with homeowners.

    • Strong communication and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain plumbing issues and available options clearly.

    • Pride in quality workmanship and doing the job right.

    • Reliable, team-oriented, and comfortable working independently.

    • Commitment to treating customers and their homes with respect.

    • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

    Bonus Qualifications:

    • Experience with water treatment and well pumps.

    • Drain and sewer experience.

    • Water heater installation and replacement experience.

    • Light commercial plumbing experience.

    • Familiarity with ServiceTitan.

    Join Our Team!

    If you're looking for a place where you can do quality plumbing work, be respected, take care of great customers, and enjoy a supportive, no-pressure work environment, we'd love to hear from you. Join Oxford Plumbing & Heating and become part of a team that values craftsmanship, integrity, and its people!

    Residential Service Plumber

    Astar Heating & Air Conditioning | Middletown, NY

    Experienced plumbers have options. The difference is finding a company that respects your expertise, keeps you busy, and gives you the support needed to solve problems the right way.

    At Astar Heating & Air Conditioning, our plumbers are trusted professionals who play an important role in the customer experience.     • Diagnose, repair, and maintain residential plumbing systems.
    • Service and install water heaters, fixtures, faucets, toilets, disposals, sump pumps, ejector pumps, and related equipment.
    • Repair water lines, drain lines, leaks, valves, and other plumbing components.
    • Perform plumbing inspections and identify code, safety, and performance concerns.
    • Explain diagnosed problems and recommend appropriate repair or replacement options.
    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.
    • Maintain accurate service notes, estimates, photos, and follow-up information.
    • Communicate parts, scheduling, and return-trip needs promptly to the office.
    • Maintain an organized vehicle, tools, materials, and assigned inventory.
    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, professional work area.
    • Participate in required meetings, technical training, and professional development.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous residential plumbing service and repair experience.
    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.
    • Knowledge of residential plumbing systems, fixtures, materials, and applicable codes.
    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.
    • Strong communication and customer service skills.
    • Ability to explain technical findings and available options clearly to homeowners.
    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality work.
    • Journeyman Plumber license or equivalent experience preferred.
    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
    • Ability to perform physical work in basements, crawl spaces, bathrooms, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Work at Astar?

    • Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities: $25 - $45/hour with weekly pay! Top techs make $100k - $150k annually!
    • Steady, year-round customer demand
    • Strong dispatch, customer service, and operational support
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
    • Company-Provided Vehicle
    • Company Phone or Tablet
    • Uniforms and Professional Tools
    • Ongoing Paid Technical and Customer Service Training
    • Career Advancement Opportunities
    • Support from an experienced home services team
    • A professional environment that values quality, accountability, and teamwork

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing plumbing problems accurately, completing dependable repairs and installations, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll maintain professional communication, document your work thoroughly, and help Astar continue earning customer trust through quality service and consistent follow-through.

    • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Journeyman plumbing license or equivalent experience preferred.

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means providing homeowners with honest recommendations, delivering high-quality repairs and installations, resolving plumbing issues efficiently, and helping Triangle continue to build lasting customer relationships through exceptional service and craftsmanship.

  • Solid understanding of water distribution and disposal systems in residential, commercial and industrial buildings

  • Ability to handle plumbing tools and equipment (pipe wrenches, pipe cutters, plungers etc.)
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Friendly with a great deal of patience
  • Good physical condition and strength with the ability to work in awkward spaces

    • Perform plumbing inspections and identify code, safety, and performance concerns.

    • Obtain customer approval before completing work and collect payment when appropriate.

    • Prepare accurate estimates and complete service notes, photos, and customer documentation.

    • Protect customers’ homes and maintain a clean, safe, and professional work area.

    • Participate in ongoing technical, safety, sales, and customer service training.

    • Previous residential plumbing service and repair experience.

    • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting abilities.

    • Knowledge of residential plumbing systems, fixtures, materials, and applicable codes.

    • Ability to independently manage service calls from diagnosis through completion.

    • Strong communication, presentation, and customer service skills.

    • Ability to explain technical findings and available solutions clearly to homeowners.

    • Comfortable recommending appropriate products and services based on customer needs.

    • Self-motivated, dependable, and driven to achieve performance goals.

    • Commitment to safe, code-compliant, and high-quality workmanship.

    • Applicable plumbing license or local credentials preferred.

    • Comfortable using tablets, mobile applications, and field service software.

    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.

    • Ability to perform physical work in basements, crawl spaces, bathrooms, and outdoor conditions.

    Why Jones Services?

    We feel a personal responsibility to the people who choose to build their careers with us. Our goal is to create a supportive workplace where every employee has the opportunity to develop their skills, maximize their potential, and advance within the company.

    We don’t look only at years of experience. We look for professionals with the right attitude, ambition, and desire to succeed. When we find those qualities, we invest in the training, coaching, tools, and support needed to help that person excel.

    Compensation and Benefits

    • Industry-leading compensation

    • Performance-based earning opportunities

    • No on-call rotation—ever

    • Steady, year-round customer demand

    • Company vehicle and gas card

    • Company-provided tablet

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Affordable Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • Health Savings Account with Company Contributions

    • Company-Paid Short-Term Disability Insurance

    • Company-Paid Long-Term Disability Insurance

    • Company-Paid Life Insurance

    • Paid Holidays

    • Paid Time Off

    • Parental Leave

    • Tuition Reimbursement

    • Tool Account

    • Safety Shoe Reimbursement

    • Friends and family discounts on company services

    • Annual Performance Reviews

    • Ongoing Technical and Customer Service Training

    • Career Advancement Opportunities

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means diagnosing plumbing problems accurately, completing dependable repairs and installations, and helping homeowners feel confident in the recommendations you provide. You’ll take ownership of your service calls, create an exceptional customer experience, and benefit from a company that recognizes strong performance while respecting your time outside of work.

    Plumbing Installer

    Carter's Plumbing, Heating & Cooling

    At Carter's Plumbing, Heating & Cooling, our mission is simple: Growing Together as a Team to Serve Every Customer with Excellence — and have fun doing it. We’re committed to providing exceptional service to our customers while creating a positive, team-oriented environment where our employees can learn, grow, and succeed.

    We’re looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys working with a team, and wants to build a career in the trades. Experience is important, but it’s not everything. If you bring the right attitude, ambition, and desire to excel, we’ll provide the training and support you need to succeed.

    Benefits

    • Competitive compensation: $20 - $45 with weekly pay!

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

    • 401(k) with Company Match

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

    • Company-Paid Life and Disability Insurance

    • Paid Training and Professional Development

    • Career Growth and Advancement Opportunities

    What You’ll Do

    • Assist with plumbing upgrades, installations, replacements, and water treatment installations

    • Complete assigned work efficiently, accurately, and according to company standards

    • Build strong relationships with customers and create a positive service experience

    • Communicate clearly with customers to understand their needs and help them make informed decisions

    • Represent the company professionally and demonstrate knowledge and confidence in your work

    • Work closely with technicians, installers, coworkers, and management to ensure jobs are completed successfully

    • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized job site

    • Follow all company policies, procedures, and safety guidelines

    • Accurately complete required paperwork, documentation, and job assignments in a timely manner

    • Help maintain company vehicles by keeping trucks clean, organized, and properly stocked with assigned inventory

    • Participate actively in company-provided training and on-the-job learning opportunities

    • Continue developing your plumbing skills and knowledge to grow within the trade

    What We’re Looking For

    • Well-rounded, self-sufficient service plumber with hands-on plumbing experience

    • Ability to work independently and confidently manage your own service van

    • ServiceTitan experience preferred

    • Strong work ethic and a positive, team-oriented attitude

    • Strong customer service and communication skills

    • Ability to build rapport and establish trust with customers

    • Professional appearance and attitude

    • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship

    • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team

    • Willingness to participate in ongoing training and professional development

    • Ability to follow instructions, company procedures, and safety standards

    • Valid driver's license and clean driving record

    Why Join Carter's?

    At Carter's Plumbing, Heating & Cooling, we believe our people are our greatest investment. Whether you’re bringing years of experience or just getting started in the trades, we’ll give you the training, support, and opportunities you need to keep growing.

    You’ll work alongside a team that values hard work, professionalism, teamwork, and having fun while doing it. If you’re ready to learn, grow, and build a career with a company that believes in its people, we’d love to have you join the Carter’s team.

    • Install, repair, and replace residential sewer laterals and water service lines.
    • Perform work using both open-trench and trenchless repair methods.
    • Excavate, expose, and prepare underground piping for repair or replacement.
    • Assist with pipe bursting, lining, boring, and other trenchless applications.
    • Install sewer, water, drainage, and related underground piping.
    • Identify utility conflicts, site conditions, and access concerns before work begins.
    • Operate excavation, compaction, cutting, pumping, and trenchless equipment safely.
    • Set grades, make pipe connections, test completed systems, and confirm proper operation.
    • Restore excavated areas, including backfilling, compaction, and site cleanup.
    • Protect customer property and maintain a clean, organized, and professional jobsite.
    • Follow trench safety, confined-space, utility-marking, and personal protective equipment requirements.
    • Maintain assigned tools, equipment, materials, and vehicle inventory.
    • Communicate job progress, material needs, and unexpected field conditions promptly.
    • Work closely with crew leaders, plumbers, equipment operators, and office staff.
    • Participate in required safety meetings, technical training, and company meetings.

    What We’re Looking For

    • Previous underground utility, sewer, water service, excavation, plumbing, or construction experience preferred.
    • Experience with sewer laterals, water services, trenching, or trenchless repair methods is a plus.
    • Strong mechanical ability and comfort working with tools and equipment.
    • Ability to read basic measurements, follow grades, and understand jobsite layouts.
    • Commitment to safe work practices and proper trench protection.
    • Dependable attendance, strong work ethic, and attention to detail.
    • Ability to follow direction and work effectively as part of a crew.
    • Professional communication and respect for customers and their property.
    • Ability to perform demanding physical work in varying weather and site conditions.
    • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record.
    • CDL, equipment operation experience, or plumbing knowledge is a plus.

    Why Work at Delco Storm & Sewer?

    • Competitive compensation based on experience
    • Steady, year-round demand for essential services
    • Hands-on training in both trench and trenchless methods
    • Exposure to specialized equipment and repair technology
    • Opportunities to advance into crew leadership, equipment operation, or plumbing roles

    • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
    • 401(k) with Company Match
    • Ongoing Safety and Technical Training
    • Supportive, Team-Oriented Work Environment

    What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means completing safe, durable underground repairs while protecting customers’ homes and property. You’ll contribute to efficient jobsites, communicate clearly with your crew, and help Delco Storm & Sewer deliver reliable solutions that homeowners can depend on.

    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe warehouse and surrounding work areas.

    • Complete necessary paperwork and inventory updates accurately and promptly.

    • Follow company safety procedures and represent Jackson Comfort professionally with coworkers, technicians, and customers.

    • A high school diploma or GED.

    • Previous warehouse, inventory, delivery, or material-handling experience preferred.

    • Basic knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, or electrical parts is a plus; training can be provided.

    • A valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

    • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management.

    • Basic computer skills and the ability to use mobile apps or inventory tracking systems.

    • Ability to communicate clearly, work independently, and collaborate effectively with a team.

    • A dependable, responsible, and team-oriented attitude with a willingness to take initiative.
